In close analogy to configuration-selective VCI theory, we propose a basis-pruning algorithm in which candidate vibrational states are represented by inexpensive approximate wavefunctions and selected according to their impact on rovibrational energies in a spectral window of interest. For formaldehyde, comparisons with widely used polyad schemes controlling the vibrational basis are provided. Calculations on thioketene benchmark the accuracy and efficiency of the pruning approach for different threshold values.

AI.tldr: 提出一种振动基组剪枝算法，用廉价近似波函数表示候选振动态，并依据其对目标光谱窗口内振转能级的影响进行筛选，避免依赖模型哈密顿量。
AI.motivation: 无模型哈密顿量的振转光谱变分计算仍具挑战，振动基组的大小与组成是主要瓶颈；已有的VCI计算虽能约简基组，但未解决"应纳入哪些振动态函数"的问题。
AI.method: 类比构型选择VCI理论，提出基组剪枝算法：候选振动态由低成本近似波函数表示，并根据其对感兴趣光谱窗口内振转能量的影响进行选择；以甲醛为对象与传统polyad方案对比，并以硫代烯酮(tHioketene)在不同阈值下基准测试精度与效率。
AI.result: 在甲醛上与广泛使用的polyad基组控制方案进行了对比；在硫代烯酮上针对不同阈值验证了剪枝方法的精度与效率。
AI.conclusion: 该剪枝策略可在不依赖模型哈密顿量的情况下有效控制振转变分计算的基组规模，并保持目标光谱窗口内的精度。

title: Does a pole in the self-energy imply a violation of the Luttinger theorem?
summary:
Luttinger theorem relates Fermi surface volume to electron density per spin $n$. It holds in an arbitrary Fermi liquid but is widely believed to break when a fermionic self-energy has a pole.
  We show that this is not necessarily the case.
  As an example, we consider a fermionic system consisting of two gapped bands, originating from a self-energy $Σ(ω, \mathbf{k})$ with a pole,
  and a narrow residual quasiparticle band crossing $ω=0$, with a small residue $Z \ll 1$
  (a residual Fermi liquid). We consider Model I, in which $Z$ also renormalizes quasiparticle bandwidth $W$ to $ZW$ and Model II, in which $W$ remains unrenormalized.
  The Green's function for such a system $G(ω, \mathbf{k})$ contains two zeros and three poles --- one from the quasiparticle band and two from the gapped bands.
  Yet, we show that in Model I, the Luttinger-Ward analysis is fully applicable
  for any $Z >0$,
  and the results are exactly the same as if the gapped bands did not exist. For Model II, the Luttinger-Ward analysis recovers once $Z$ exceeds some critical value, which depends on fermionic density.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"费米子自能出现极点时Luttinger定理必然失效"的普遍看法，通过构建两个含极点自能的模型证明该定理仍可在特定条件下成立。
AI.motivation: Luttinger定理将费米面体积与每自旋电子密度n联系起来，在任意费米液体中成立，但普遍认为当费米子自能出现极点时会失效。作者希望检验这一"失效"论断是否绝对。
AI.method: 构造含两个能隙带（源于带极点的自能Σ(ω,k)）及一个以ω=0交叉的窄残余准粒子带（小残量Z≪1）的费米子系统。分别考察Model I（Z同时将准粒子带宽W重整化为ZW）和Model II（W不被重整化），分析其Green函数G(ω,k)（含两个零点和三个极点：一个来自准粒子带，两个来自能隙带）并进行Luttinger-Ward分析。
AI.result: Model I中，对任意Z>0，Luttinger-Ward分析完全适用，结果与能隙带不存在时完全相同；Model II中，当Z超过一个依赖于费米密度的临界值后，Luttinger-Ward分析得以恢复。
AI.conclusion: 自能存在极点并不必然导致Luttinger定理失效；在满足特定条件（如Model I任意Z，或Model II中Z超过临界值）时，Luttinger-Ward分析仍然适用且定理成立。

title: Exchange-controlled quantum beats and entanglement in an exciton--bimodal-cavity system
summary: We theoretically demonstrate tunable population transfer and entanglement generation in a two-exciton system coupled to a bimodal optical cavity, including an exciton-exciton exchange interaction. By using dressed-state transformations and Löwdin partitioning, we derive effective Hamiltonians that identify three dynamical time scales: local polaritonic oscillations, long-period dressed-state beats, and direct excitonic exchange. We apply the framework to graphene nanoribbon excitons, using excitonic energies, transition dipoles, and lifetimes obtained from first-principles calculations to parameterize the model. In the small- and moderate-exchange regimes, the dynamics become multiscale, and the beat channel sustains sizable quantum entanglement over long dissipative time windows. In the large-exchange regime, the excitonic Hamiltonian dominates and drives nearly complete population transfer between excitonic states over many coherent cycles. The resulting analytical expressions provide direct design rules connecting the beat period, transfer amplitude, and coherent-cycle number to the exchange interaction, cavity detuning, and light--matter coupling. Our results establish a controllable route for engineering long-lived entanglement and coherent excitonic operations in exciton--bimodal-cavity systems.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究双激子体系与双模光学腔耦合（含激子-激子交换作用）中的可调布居转移与纠缠产生，推导有效哈密顿量并通过石墨烯纳米带激子参数验证。
AI.motivation: 探索在激子-双模腔系统中工程化长寿命纠缠与相干激子操作的可行途径，理解激子交换作用对多尺度动力学的影响。
AI.method: 采用缀饰态变换与Löwdin分区法推导有效哈密顿量，识别三个动力学时间尺度（局域极化激元振荡、长周期缀饰态拍频、直接激子交换）；用第一性原理计算的石墨烯纳米带激子能量、跃迁偶极和寿命参数化模型。
AI.result: 小/中等交换区间动力学呈多尺度，拍频通道在长耗散窗口内维持可观纠缠；大交换区间激子哈密顿量主导，实现近乎完全的激子态布居转移。给出拍频周期、转移振幅、相干周期数与交换作用、腔失谐和光-物质耦合的解析设计规则。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为激子-双模腔系统中工程长寿命纠缠与相干激子操作提供了可控路径。

title: Casimir Force, Magnetization, and Susceptibility for \\ Ising Chain with an Impurity Atom in the Presence of an External Field
summary: The article contains exact results for the behavior of the Casimir force of Ising chain of $N$ atoms containing an impurity atom. The force is considered as a function of $N$ and on both the temperature $T$ and the external magnetic field $h$. The interactions between nearest neighbors within the chain are supposed to be of a ferromagnetic short-ranged type $J>0$. The impurity atom interacts with constants $J_{ia}$ with its nearest neighbors, where $J_{ia}$ can be both of ferromagnetic type, i.e., $J_{ia}>0$, as well as of antiferromagnetic type, i.e., $J_{ia}<0$. It turns out that the Casimir force can be both attractive or repulsive, depending on the sign and the magnitude of the ratio $J_{ia}/J$.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了含一个杂质原子的N原子Ising链Casimir力的精确结果，力依赖N、温度T和磁场h，可表现为吸引或排斥，取决于杂质耦合比Jia/J。
AI.motivation: 研究含杂质的一维Ising链中Casimir力的行为，理解杂质耦合对力的性质（吸引/排斥）的影响。
AI.method: 考虑铁磁短程近邻相互作用J>0的Ising链，引入一个杂质原子，其与近邻耦合为Jia（可正可负），精确求解Casimir力关于N、T、h的依赖关系。
AI.result: Casimir力既可为吸引也可为排斥，取决于Jia/J的符号与大小。
AI.conclusion: 杂质耦合比Jia/J是决定Casimir力吸引或排斥性质的关键参数。

title: Materials and Metrology for Out-of-Plane Damping-Like Spin-Orbit Torque
summary: A new generation of energy-efficient, high-density, and non-volatile memory devices could be enabled if a more efficient mechanism is developed for switching the magnetization orientation of nanoscale magnetic devices possessing perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. A promising strategy under widespread investigation is current-induced damping-like spin-orbit torque with a strong unconventional out-of-plane component, rather than only the conventional in-plane component. In recent years, such torques have been reported in a broad range of materials platforms, arising primarily from three classes of symmetry breaking within the material generating the torque: low crystal symmetry in single-crystalline materials, antiferromagnetic order, and ferromagnetic order. Despite this progress, the field remains fragmented. Measurements using different methods often disagree, artifacts have been misinterpreted, and qualitative observations are sometimes overinterpreted as evidence of technological promise. This Perspective will provide a critical overview of out-of-plane damping-like spin-orbit torques, analyzing the classes of materials which can generate such torques, the experimental methods by which the torques can be quantified, and the progress toward achieving torque efficiencies sufficient for scalable magnetic technologies.

AI.tldr: 综述垂直各向异性磁体中面外阻尼类自旋轨道力矩的产生机制、测量方法与技术前景。
AI.motivation: 新一代能效高、密度高、非易失的存储器件需要更高效的纳米磁体磁化翻转机制。具有强非常规面外分量的电流诱导阻尼类自旋轨道力矩是有前景的策略，但该领域研究分散、测量结果不一致、伪影被误读。
AI.method: 以Perspective形式对相关文献进行批判性综述，分析可产生此类力矩的三类对称破缺（单晶低晶体对称性、反铁磁序、铁磁序）及量化力矩的实验方法。
AI.result: 总结了面外阻尼类自旋轨道力矩在多种材料平台中被报道；指出不同测量方法常相互矛盾，伪影被误判，定性观察有时被过度解读为技术前景证据。
AI.conclusion: 该领域仍较分散，需要统一的测量标准和严谨解读，并评估力矩效率是否足以支撑可扩展的磁性技术应用。

title: MUTACO: Simulator-Efficient Response Matching in Stochastic Nonlinear Systems via Compatibility-Aware Sequential Design
summary: Many physical inverse problems are mediated by expensive stochastic simulators for which response gradients, adjoint sensitivities, or a differentiable simulator interface are unavailable. We introduce Multiple Target-based Confident Acquisition (MUTACO), an uncertainty-aware sequential-design method for response matching that requires only noisy forward evaluations and learns the multicomponent response together with its predictive uncertainty. We develop and evaluate MUTACO for a disordered network of stochastic phase oscillators. The inverse task is to infer statistical properties of the local potential and interactions from macroscopic rotation and synchronization curves under multiple driving conditions. Rather than requiring unique recovery of these statistical properties, MUTACO searches for parameter configurations whose predicted rotation and synchronization responses are compatible with the target response while accounting for predictive uncertainty. This response-centered formulation is appropriate when experimentally accessible observables characterize ensemble statistics rather than a particular microscopic realization. Under strictly limited simulation budgets, MUTACO achieves the lowest held-out response error among the tested adaptive-search, space-filling, and simulation-based inference methods, while also yielding lower parameter-recovery error than the compared methods. These results demonstrate that response-targeted sequential design is a simulator-efficient approach to inverse modeling from finite noisy forward evaluations and suggest broader applicability to stochastic physical systems with correlated multicomponent responses and weakly constrained parameter directions.

AI.tldr: 提出MUTACO，一种仅需噪声前向评估、面向响应匹配的不确定性感知序列设计方法，用于求解随机模拟器驱动的物理逆问题，并在随机相位振子网络上验证其优于主流方法。
AI.motivation: 许多物理逆问题的模拟器成本高昂，且无法获得响应梯度、伴随灵敏度或可微接口。实验可观测的往往是系综统计量，而非特定微观实现，因此不必强求参数唯一恢复。
AI.method: MUTACO（Multiple Target-based Confident Acquisition）顺序设计方法：仅依赖含噪前向评估，同时学习多分量响应及其预测不确定性；在多个驱动条件下，从宏观旋转与同步曲线推断局部势与相互作用的统计性质，寻找预测响应与目标响应兼容的参数配置。
AI.result: 在严格有限的模拟预算下，MUTACO在留出响应误差上取得最低值，优于自适应搜索、空间填充和基于模拟的推断方法，同时参数恢复误差也更低。
AI.conclusion: 面向响应的序列设计是仅凭有限含噪前向评估进行逆建模的高效途径，可推广至具有多分量相关响应和弱约束参数方向的随机物理系统。

title: Spinorial Weyl Operator Reduction of Dirac (SWORD): Exact Relativistic Quantum Chemistry with Half the Spinor
comment: Draft version, might be further improved with even more data
summary: We present an exact self-consistent two-component reformulation of the Dirac equation in the Weyl representation. By exploiting the diagonal structure of the kinetic operator and the purely scalar mass coupling in the Weyl basis, the four-component Dirac problem is reduced to an exact two-component form without introducing inverse-potential operators that arise in conventional energy-decoupling approaches. The resulting second-order differential equations are cast into an integral formulation and solved iteratively via convolution with the Helmholtz Green's function. We implement this formalism within an adaptive multiwavelet basis framework, providing rigorous, user-defined error control. Proof-of-concept calculations for simple atomic systems demonstrate the numerical stability, accuracy, and efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

AI.tldr: 在Weyl表象下提出Dirac方程的精确自洽二分量重构，结合Helmholtz格林函数迭代求解并采用自适应多小波基实现严格误差控制。
AI.motivation: 传统能量退耦方法在将四分量Dirac方程降为二分量时会引入逆势算子，造成数值困难。本文希望避免此类算子，实现精确二分量表述。
AI.method: 利用Weyl基下动能算子的对角结构和纯标量质量耦合，将四分量Dirac问题精确约化为二分量形式；所得二阶微分方程转化为积分形式，用Helmholtz格林函数卷积迭代求解；在自适应多小波基框架内实现，提供用户定义的严格误差控制。
AI.result: 对简单原子体系的原理验证计算表明，该算法具有数值稳定性、精度和效率。
AI.conclusion: 该自洽二分量Dirac方法避免逆势算子，配合多小波基与迭代积分求解，可稳定高效地求解相对论电子结构问题。

title: Peeling off Abelian Anyons and Proliferation Transitions
summary: We study the invertible one-form global symmetry of a (2+1)-dimensional topological quantum field theory (TQFT). A universal description of this symmetry ``peels off'' all the Abelian anyons from the rest of the TQFT. This allows us to study this symmetry and some of its consequences, independently of the details of the rest of the system. We then describe these Abelian anyons using $\mathrm{U}(1)$ gauge fields with Chern-Simons terms and couple them to a scalar field, thus constructing a particular non-topological theory. This new theory, our transition field theory, exhibits a phase transition from the original TQFT to another phase. The latter is either gapless or another TQFT. This discussion generalizes and extends our earlier work (arXiv:2603.00245). In particular, we give a more detailed description of the global symmetries and their fates in the various phases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究(2+1)维拓扑量子场论(TQFT)的可逆一形式整体对称性，提出一种"剥离"所有阿贝尔任意子的普适描述，并构造过渡场论研究相变。
AI.motivation: 作者希望独立于TQFT其余细节，研究其可逆一形式整体对称性及其后果，并推广此前的工作(arXiv:2603.00245)。
AI.method: 利用可逆一形式整体对称性的普适描述剥离阿贝尔任意子；用带Chern-Simons项的U(1)规范场描述这些任意子，并将其与标量场耦合，构造非拓扑的"过渡场论"。
AI.result: 过渡场论展现出从原TQFT到另一相的相变；新相要么是无能隙相，要么是另一个TQFT。文中更详细描述了整体对称性及其在不同相中的命运。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推广并扩展了作者此前的研究，为理解TQFT相变中的整体对称性提供了普适框架。

title: Micromagnet engineering for enhanced addressability of donor-cluster arrays in silicon
summary: Phosphorus donors in silicon are one of the promising platforms for fault-tolerant quantum computing, owing to their long coherence times and compatibility with complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technology. However, a key bottleneck for scaling this platform lies in the independent addressability of individual spin qubits. Here, we present a scalable quantum processor architecture that integrates scanning tunneling microscope (STM)-defined phosphorus donor-cluster arrays with on-chip micromagnets. By generating magnetic field gradients, the micromagnets enable a broader addressable frequency range compared to the addressing scheme based solely on variations in hyperfine (HF) interactions, which arise from the randomness of intra-cluster configurations. Through micromagnetic simulations to optimize micromagnet geometry, we demonstrate that these structures are compatible with customized array designs, facilitating the integration of over 120 atomic spin qubits and enabling frequency multiplexing with a single microwave antenna, which greatly reduces the overhead of fan-out addressing lines. This design is further validated via magnetic measurements, which generally align with our micromagnetic simulations. These results establish a critical foundation for the development of scalable silicon quantum computing with atomic qubits.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种将STM定义的磷供体团簇阵列与片上微磁体集成的可扩展量子处理器架构，通过磁场梯度实现更宽的寻址频率范围，支持超过120个原子自旋量子比特的频率复用寻址。
AI.motivation: 磷供体自旋量子比特具有长相干时间和CMOS兼容性，但单个自旋量子比特的独立寻址是扩展该平台的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 将STM定义的磷供体团簇阵列与片上微磁体集成，利用微磁体产生磁场梯度，并通过微磁模拟优化微磁体几何结构，设计兼容定制阵列的架构。
AI.result: 相比仅依赖超精细相互作用随机性的寻址方案，微磁体提供了更宽的寻址频率范围；模拟与磁测量结果基本一致；支持集成超过120个原子自旋量子比特，并可用单个微波天线实现频率复用，减少扇出寻址线开销。
AI.conclusion: 该设计为基于原子量子比特的可扩展硅量子计算奠定了基础。

title: From Equilibrium Criticality to Universal Collective Phases through Nonreciprocal Coupling of Ordered Systems
summary: Nonreciprocal interactions have emerged as a fundamental driver of collective behavior far from equilibrium. Here, we show that nonreciprocal couplings between spin systems whose isolated dynamics favors ordered states, beyond the previously identified oscillatory (swap) phase, give rise to a richer nonequilibrium phenomenology, including a multistable regime where ordered and disordered states coexist, a scenario strictly forbidden in equilibrium. Crucially, we show that this nonequilibrium phenomenology is inherited directly from the critical properties of the underlying isolated model. In particular, tricriticality in the isolated system gives rise to multistability, hysteresis, and hard excitations in the oscillatory dynamics, while non-normal interactions further enrich the phase diagram by generating multistability. Moving beyond mean-field theory, we derive a universal field equation governing the onset of these nonreciprocal oscillations in finite dimensions. Our results establish a unified theoretical framework connecting critical phenomena, dynamical systems, and non-reciprocal collective dynamics, with applications ranging from opinion dynamics to active matter

AI.tldr: 非互易耦合使有序自旋系统在振荡相之外涌现多稳、滞后与硬激发等非平衡现象，这些现象直接继承自孤立模型的临界性质。
AI.motivation: 非互易相互作用是非平衡集体行为的核心驱动力。此前识别出的振荡（交换）相之外，尚缺乏统一框架解释非互易耦合如何从孤立系统的临界性产生更丰富的非平衡现象。
AI.method: 研究孤立动力学倾向有序态的自旋系统间的非互易耦合，进行平均场分析；发现孤立系统中的三临界性导致多稳、滞后和硬激发；非正规模相互作用进一步丰富相图；并推导有限维下控制非互易振荡出现的一般场方程。
AI.result: 在振荡相之外发现有序与无序态共存的多稳区（平衡态严格禁止）；该非平衡现象直接继承孤立模型的临界性质：三临界性产生多稳、滞后和硬激发；非正规模作用额外产生多稳；并导出有限维普适场方程。
AI.conclusion: 建立了连接临界现象、动力系统与非互易集体动力学的统一理论框架，可应用于观点动力学和活性物质等领域。

title: Floquet dressing of bulk metallic bands in 2H-NbSe2
comment: Main text:20 pages, 4 figures; SI: 20 pages, 9 figures. Comments are welcome
summary: Floquet dressing offers a route to controlling electronic states through periodic optical driving. Its realization in solids has centred primarily on topological-insulator surface states, semiconductors and two-dimensional Dirac semimetals. Extending this control to bulk metals would enable manipulation of the itinerant states underlying metallic transport and collective order. Yet strong screening and rapid scattering have long cast doubt on its feasibility in bulk metals, while photoelectron dressing complicates its identification. Here we identify Floquet dressing of the overlapping, bulk-derived metallic bands of 2H-NbSe2 using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Photon-shifted replicas in a sparse unoccupied-state window retain the parent-band dispersions and appear only during pump--probe overlap. Rotating the pump's linear polarization at fixed probe polarization redistributes replica weight between momentum-space branches. With a common parameter set, a model accounting for the optical fields inside and outside the solid captures this redistribution through coherent Floquet--Volkov interference more closely than either pathway alone or their incoherent intensity sum. These findings extend Floquet dressing to the itinerant bulk bands of a multiband metal without relying on the observation of energy gaps opened by hybridization between parent bands and their photon-dressed replicas, providing a basis for exploring how coherent optical dressing couples to metallic transport and collective electronic phases.

AI.tldr: 本文利用时间与角分辨光电子谱在块体金属2H-NbSe2中识别出Floquet dressing：在稀疏未占据态窗口中出现光子位移复制带，保留母带色散且仅在泵浦-探测重叠期出现；旋转线偏振可重新分配复制带权重，模型显示相干Floquet-Volkov干涉比单一路径或非相干叠加更符合实验。
AI.motivation: Floquet dressing此前主要在拓扑绝缘体表面态、半导体和二维Dirac半金属中实现；将其扩展到块体金属可调控金属输运与集体序所依赖的巡游电子态。但块体金属中的强屏蔽和快速散射长期令人怀疑其可行性，光电子dressing也增加了识别难度。
AI.method: 用时间分辨与角分辨光电子谱（tr-ARPES）研究2H-NbSe2重叠的块体来源金属带；通过泵浦-探测重叠窗口观测光子位移复制带；旋转泵浦光线性偏振（固定探测偏振）以重新分配动量空间分支间的复制带权重；构建包含固体内外光场的模型，比较相干Floquet-Volkov干涉、单一途径及非相干强度叠加对权重再分配的描述。
AI.result: 在稀疏未占据态窗口观察到光子位移复制带，其保留母带色散且仅存在于泵浦-探测重叠期；旋转泵浦偏振可重新分配复制带在动量空间分支间的权重；同一参数下，相干Floquet-Volkov干涉模型比单独途径或非相干强度叠加更准确地捕捉该重新分配。
AI.conclusion: 研究将Floquet dressing扩展到多带金属的巡游块体带，且不依赖母带与光子dressed复制带杂化开隙的观测，为探索相干光dressing如何耦合金属输运和集体电子相提供了基础。

title: Band Structure Modulation in Ternary-Based InAs/ AlAs1-xSbx /InAs1-xSbx Superlattices
summary: This study demonstrates an overall view of recent quantum mechanical based modeling effort using empirical tight-binding method to expand the ability of calculation of electronic band structure for strained-layer superlattices composed of ternary InAs/InAs1-xSbx and InAs/InAs1-xSbx/AlAs1-xSbx materials. Using a modified sp3s* empirical tight-binding method and building the superlattice Hamiltonian, we demonstrate that combining the virtual crystal approximation with a bowing parameter for the s-on-site energy accurately predicts ternary superlattice behavior. We provide a comprehensive overview of our numerical simulations, which model diverse superlattice configurations ranging from long wavelength infrared range to wide-bandgap barrier architectures. Notably, the simulated energy levels strongly agree with experimental bandgap measurements of the ternary superlattices and their structural variants.

AI.tldr: 本文用改进的sp3s*紧束缚方法结合虚晶近似，建立了三元InAs/InAs1-xSbx及InAs/InAs1-xSbx/AlAs1-xSbx应变超晶格的电子能带模型，模拟结果与实验带隙吻合良好。
AI.motivation: 扩展三元材料应变超晶格电子能带结构计算能力，为红外探测及宽禁带势垒结构提供可靠的理论建模手段。
AI.method: 采用改进的sp3s*经验紧束缚方法构建超晶格哈密顿量，并将虚晶近似与s在位能的弯曲参数（bowing parameter）相结合来准确预测三元超晶格行为。
AI.result: 数值模拟覆盖从长波红外到宽禁带势垒的多种超晶格构型，模拟能级与三元超晶格及其结构变体的实验带隙测量高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该建模方法能准确描述三元应变超晶格的电子能带结构，验证了虚晶近似加弯曲参数处理三元组分的有效性。

title: Out-of-Plane Oscillating Electric Fields Unlock Low-Temperature Nonequilibrium Superionicity in Quasi-Two-Dimensional AgCrSe2
summary: Superionic conductors enable exceptionally fast ion transport in solids and offer broad technological potential. However, their highly conductive states are typically accessed only above the order-disorder transition of the mobile-ion sublattice, which limits low-temperature operation. Here, electric-field-responsive machine-learning molecular dynamics reveals a nonequilibrium route to superionic transport in quasi-two-dimensional AgCrSe2 driven by an out-of-plane oscillating electric field. At 300 K, far below the transition temperature near 475 K, the field activates fast in-plane Ag+ transport with an ionic conductivity reaching ~1.7 S/cm. This originates from field-driven dynamic disorder of Ag+ across two equivalent sublattices rather than thermally induced disordering. With increasing frequency, the Ag occupation evolves from complete switching to a highly conductive dynamically disordered state and finally to an ordered state with weak field response. These regimes shift to higher frequencies with increasing temperature or field amplitude, consistent with competition between the driving period and Ag-sublattice response time. At strong fields, this timescale is consistent with field-assisted thermal activation, while weak-field deviations suggest additional dynamics beyond single-ion activation. These results suggest timescale-matched periodic driving as a route to transport-active ionic disorder far below an equilibrium superionic transition.

AI.tldr: 通过电场响应的机器学习分子动力学，揭示振荡电场可在远低于有序-无序转变温度下驱动AgCrSe₂进入超离子态。
AI.motivation: 超离子导体的高导电态通常只在移动离子亚晶格的有序-无序转变温度以上才能实现，限制了低温工作，因此需寻找非平衡途径在低温下获得超离子输运。
AI.method: 采用电场响应的机器学习分子动力学模拟，对准二维AgCrSe₂施加面外振荡电场，研究其对Ag⁺面内输运和亚晶格占据的调控。
AI.result: 在300 K（远低于~475 K转变温度）下，电场激活快速面内Ag⁺输运，离子电导率达~1.7 S/cm；机制为电场驱动的Ag⁺在两等价亚晶格间动态无序，而非热致无序。随频率升高，Ag占据从完全切换演变为高导动态无序态，再变为弱响应的有序态；这些区域随温度或场幅增大移向更高频率，符合驱动周期与Ag亚晶格响应时间的竞争。
AI.conclusion: 时间尺度匹配的周期性驱动是实现远低于平衡超离子转变温度的输运活性离子无序的可行途径；强场符合场辅助热激活，弱场偏差暗示存在超越单离子激活的额外动力学。

title: Optimizing the Optimizer: Language Models Discover Faster Molecular Relaxation
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/vdeshchenya/autosella
summary: Geometry optimization is a major cost in many quantum-chemical workflows: each optimization step requires one force evaluation, and at the density-functional level that evaluation dominates the wall time. Research in this area has produced a broad range of optimization methods, and we ask whether a language model can improve on the best of them through autoresearch. An agent rewrites the optimizer itself to minimize force-call counts, restrained by two admission gates that reject premature stopping and improvements that do not generalize to unseen molecules. Starting from Sella, the fastest open-source optimizer available, the search produces AutoSella, a family of two optimizers. Both of them deliver consistent force-call reductions relative to Sella across held-out molecular benchmarks and potentials not used during the search. Most notably, at the \texttt{r2SCAN-3c} DFT level, the best variant requires only $40.2$--$77.2\%$ of Sella's force calls while achieving the same energy reduction, even though agent used no DFT gradients.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用语言模型驱动的"自动研究"(autoresearch)来改进几何优化器，从Sella出发演化出AutoSella，在未见分子上显著减少力调用次数。
AI.motivation: 几何优化中每步都需评估力，DFT级别下力评估主导计算时间，因此减少力调用次数是核心成本问题。作者想问：语言模型能否在自动研究中超越现有最优优化器。
AI.method: 一个agent改写优化器本身以最小化力调用次数，并设置两个准入闸门：拒绝过早停止、拒绝无法泛化到未见分子的改进。搜索以开源最快优化器Sella为起点。
AI.result: 产生AutoSella系列（两种优化器），在留出分子基准和搜索时未见势能面上相对Sella减少力调用。在r2SCAN-3c DFT级别，最佳变体只需Sella力调用次数的40.2%–77.2%，达到相同能量下降，且搜索过程未用DFT梯度。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型agent通过自动研究可发现泛化性强的优化器改进，显著降低几何优化成本，暗示自动研究在量子化学方法开发中的潜力。

title: Spatiotemporal imaging of microwave magnetic fields via magnonic coherent splitting
summary: Spatiotemporal microwave magnetic-field imaging reveals current flow in high-frequency circuits and nonequilibrium spin dynamics, yet probes rarely combine calibrated spectral readout, optics-free operation and transient mapping at room temperature. Here ferrimagnetic order in yttrium iron garnet supports coherent coupling from a pump-induced magnon mode, converting target-field amplitude into a spectral splitting with all-microwave readout. Sampling the calibrated splitting over position and delay reconstructs spatiotemporal imaging of magnetic fields. Continuous-wave measurement reaches a sensitivity of 58 pT/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ and recovers phases across various powers. Combined with time-resolved frequency-comb spectroscopy, the method reconstructs transient fields with a 130-ns response time. Coplanar-waveguide imaging validates the magnetic selectivity of the mode-splitting readout, where measured maps agree with simulated magnetic-field distribution. In a microwave amplifier, our reconstruction resolves nonuniform switching dynamics and detects downstream field suppression from an open-contact fault. Magnonic coherent splitting provides a scalable route for optics-free imaging of spatiotemporal field evolution in functional devices.

AI.tldr: 利用钇铁石榴石中的磁振子模式相干劈裂，实现室温、无需光学手段的时空磁场成像，灵敏度58 pT/√Hz，瞬态响应130 ns。
AI.motivation: 高频电路中的电流分布与非平衡自旋动力学需要时空磁场成像，但现有探针难以同时满足标定谱读取、无需光学操作和室温瞬态成像三重要求。
AI.method: 借助钇铁石榴石中的亚铁磁序，使泵浦诱导的磁振子模式发生相干耦合，将目标场幅度转化为可全微波读取的谱劈裂；在空间与延迟上采样标定后的劈裂，重建时空磁场；结合连续波测量与时间分辨频率梳谱获取瞬态场。
AI.result: 连续波测量灵敏度达58 pT/√Hz，可跨功率恢复相位；瞬态场响应时间130 ns；共面波导成像验证磁选择性，测量图与模拟磁场分布一致；在微波放大器中分辨非均匀开关动力学并检出开路故障导致的下游场抑制。
AI.conclusion: 磁振子相干劈裂为功能性器件中时空场演化的无光学、可扩展成像提供了新途径。

title: New dimensions in magnetism and superconductivity via 3D nanoprinting with focused electron and ion beams
summary: The extension of nanoscale quantum materials to the third dimension brings new possibilities to geometrically tune emergent properties, emulating or indeed going beyond the physics of bulk materials, with exciting implications for high-density technological integration. Realising such three-dimensional architectures requires nanofabrication techniques that not only enable complex 3D geometries, but also deliver functional quantum materials with emergent phenomena. Recent advances in focused electron- and ion-beam induced deposition (FEBID and FIBID) have made 3D nanopatterning of functional materials in complex geometries increasingly feasible, paving the way for the experimental realisation of new phenomena and device prototyping. In this review, we discuss the use of FEBID and FIBID 3D nanopatterning of superconducting and magnetic materials. We address the underlying mechanisms, and capabilities of these techniques, focusing on the physical phenomena that become accessible. Considering the resolution of the techniques in the context of the fundamental lengthscales of the materials, we discuss the emergent effects that arise due to three dimensional geometries in magnetic and superconducting nanostructures, and highlight perspectives for future developments of the techniques.

AI.tldr: 本综述讨论利用聚焦电子/离子束诱导沉积（FEBID/FIBID）实现超导与磁性材料的3D纳米图案化，分析其机理、能力及由此带来的磁性/超导纳米结构中的涌现效应。
AI.motivation: 将纳米量子材料扩展到三维可几何调控涌现性质、模拟甚至超越体材料物理，利于高密度技术集成，但需要既能构筑复杂3D几何又能提供具涌现现象的功能量子材料的纳米制造技术。
AI.method: 综述FEBID与FIBID的3D纳米图案化技术，阐述其底层机制与能力，并结合材料基本长度尺度讨论技术分辨率。
AI.result: FEBID/FIBID近期的进展使复杂几何中功能材料的3D纳米图案化日益可行，为实验实现新现象与器件原型铺路，并揭示了3D几何在磁性与超导纳米结构中引发的涌现效应。
AI.conclusion: FEBID/FIBID 3D纳米图案化可推动新物理现象的实验实现与器件原型化，并指出该技术未来发展的方向。

title: Kilovolt-class Vertical (011) \b{eta}-Ga2O3 Schottky Diodes for High Voltage and High Temperature Applications
summary: We report kilovolt-class vertical (011) \b{eta}-Ga2O3 Schottky diodes utilizing high-permittivity dielectric TiO2/Al2O3 field-plate for high voltage and high temperature applications. A systematic study was performed with Pt/(011) \b{eta}-Ga2O3 Schottky barrier diodes (SBDs) with varied diameters from 100 μm to 300 μm, for both with and without field-plate, that revealed excellent consistency of reverse blocking performance regardless of diode area. The field-plate SBDs achieved superior breakdown voltages (3.90 - 4.16 kV) compared to the diodes without field-plate (3.06 - 3.16 kV) owing to effective edge termination. Furthermore, we explored high-temperature performance of the field-plate (011) \b{eta}-Ga2O3 diodes that revealed excellent forward conduction properties and high rectification ratio (~10^9) throughout the temperature range (25 - 150 C). At reverse bias, the field-plate diodes also exhibited kV-range breakdown voltage with no evident increase in leakage current up to the explored elevated temperature of 150 C. The low area-dependence of breakdown voltage, excellent forward transport properties, and minimal reverse leakage at both high-voltage and elevated temperature demonstrate the exciting potential of (011) \b{eta}-Ga2O3 SBDs in high-temperature power switches. Thus, our work demonstrates the strategy of advancing the performance of vertical \b{eta}-Ga2O3 SBDs by utilizing the advantageous (011) \b{eta}-Ga2O3 epilayers with low background doping, reduced killer dislocation effects, and effective field management for high-voltage and high-temperature applications.

AI.tldr: 本工作报道了基于高介电常数TiO2/Al2O3场板的千伏级(011) β-Ga2O3垂直肖特基二极管，实现了高击穿电压(最高4.16 kV)和优异的高温性能，展示了其在高温功率开关领域的潜力。
AI.motivation: 面向高压、高温功率开关应用，需要提升垂直β-Ga2O3肖特基二极管的击穿电压和高温稳定性。作者希望利用(011) β-Ga2O3外延层的低背景掺杂与位错抑制优势，并结合有效的电场管理来推进器件性能。
AI.method: 制备了不同直径(100-300 μm)的Pt/(011) β-Ga2O3 SBDs，分别在有/无场板条件下对比。采用高介电常数TiO2/Al2O3介质场板实现边缘终端，并系统测试室温至150℃下的正向与反向特性。
AI.result: 场板SBDs击穿电压(3.90-4.16 kV)明显高于无场板器件(3.06-3.16 kV)。反向阻断性能对二极管面积不敏感，一致性良好。高温(25-150℃)下保持优异正向导通特性和~10^9的高整流比，反向漏电流无明显增加，仍保持千伏级击穿。
