title: First-Principles Investigation of Multimodal Toxic Gas Sensing in Carbon-Tuned hBN-Graphene Alloys: Chemiresistive, Work-Function, and Optical Responses
summary: Compact, reliable, and cost-effective gas sensors have become a highly demanding subject for safety management in the medical sector, chemical manufacturing, food quality monitoring, agriculture, and industrial safety. Hazardous gas emissions need to be controlled and monitored with fast-responsive and highly sensitive sensing devices. A first-principles study employing density functional theory (DFT) was used to investigate the adsorption behavior of Cl2, CO, CO2, NO, NO2, and HCN gas molecules with our proposed alloys, which consisted of hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) and graphene (Gr). The alloy consisting of 22% carbon (BNGr-2) was found to be most competent for sensing Cl2, CO, CO2, and HCN with sufficient adsorption energy, charge transfer, and bandgap alteration. However, NO and NO2 gas molecules showed more engagement with 33% carbon-proportioned alloy (BNGr-3) in terms of adequate gas sensing properties. NOx gases exhibited the most chemiresistive sensitivity towards the adsorbents. Other gases also showed significant chemiresistive sensitivity and distinct selectivity ratios, which would facilitate these alloys as chemiresistive sensors. Besides, noticeable work function variation (~20%) of these systems manifested potential as work function based sensors. Cl2 and NO2 showed strong physical adsorption, while the rest of the gases were weakly to moderately physisorbed, resulting in very short recovery times (10-1 ~ 10-6 seconds). Additionally, the distinctive absorption spectra observed for the gas analyte systems highlighted the potential of the proposed alloys as optical gas sensors. Temperature variation revealed that all gas molecules can be freed from the adsorbent BNGr-2 at 425 K. These findings imply hBN-Gr alloys as promising gas sensors for pollution auditing.

AI.tldr: 该文用DFT研究hBN-石墨烯合金（BNGr-2/3）对Cl2、CO、CO2、NO、NO2、HCN的吸附，评估其作为化学电阻、功函数及光学气体传感器的潜力。
AI.motivation: 医疗、化工、食品、农业及工业安全领域对紧凑、可靠、低成本且快速灵敏的有害气体传感器需求迫切，因此需要寻找合适的气体传感材料。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT），研究Cl2、CO、CO2、NO、NO2、HCN在由六方氮化硼（hBN）与石墨烯（Gr）构成的合金上的吸附行为，并分析吸附能、电荷转移、带隙变化、功函数、吸收光谱及温度影响。
AI.result: 22%碳合金（BNGr-2）对Cl2、CO、CO2、HCN传感最佳；33%碳合金（BNGr-3）对NO和NO2响应更强。NOx化学电阻灵敏度最高，其他气体也有明显灵敏度与选择性；功函数变化约20%；Cl2和NO2为强物理吸附，其余为弱至中等物理吸附，恢复时间仅10⁻¹~10⁻⁶秒；各气体体系吸收光谱各异；425 K下所有气体可从BNGr-2脱附。
AI.conclusion: hBN-Gr合金在化学电阻、功函数及光学气体传感方面均具潜力，是有望用于污染监测的气体传感器材料。

title: Unveiling High-Energy Ultrafast Responses Driven by Fermi-Level Gap Opening in Charge-Density Waves
summary: Ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy is indispensable for investigating interactions, collective excitations, and nonequilibrium dynamics in superconductors and correlated electron systems. However, how a small gap opening near Fermi surface affects the spectral changes in the high-energy interband transition region remains elusive. To address this issue, we perform systematic studies of carrier relaxation dynamics in the prototype charge-density-wave (CDW) material EuAl4. We find that the CDW gap shrinks substantially under optical pumping. This band renormalization strongly modulates interband transitions associated with the gap edge, inducing a pronounced transient reflectivity change at the corresponding probe energies. These results establish a direct link between low-energy order-parameter dynamics and high-energy spectral responses, providing a general framework for interpreting transient signals in gapped quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用超快泵浦-探测光谱研究电荷密度波材料EuAl4的载流子弛豫动力学，发现光激发下CDW能隙显著收缩，这种能带重整化调制了带间跃迁，在相应探测能量处产生显著的瞬态反射率变化，建立了低能序参量动力学与高能光谱响应的直接联系。
AI.motivation: 超快泵浦-探测光谱是研究超导体和关联电子系统的重要工具，但费米面附近小能隙打开如何影响高能带间跃迁区的光谱变化仍不清楚，这一问题亟待解决。
AI.method: 对原型电荷密度波（CDW）材料EuAl4进行系统性的载流子弛豫动力学研究，采用超快泵浦-探测光谱实验方法。
AI.result: 发现CDW能隙在光泵浦下显著收缩，这种能带重整化强烈调制了与能隙边缘相关的带间跃迁，在对应探测能量处诱导出显著的瞬态反射率变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果建立了低能序参量动力学与高能光谱响应之间的直接联系，为解释带隙量子材料中的瞬态信号提供了通用框架。

title: Electron-phonon control of obstructed and quantum spin Hall topology in an altermagnet
comment: Main text: 5 pages with 5 PDF figures, and Supplemental Material: 8 pages with 2 PDF figures; Comments are welcome
summary: We theoretically demonstrate control over the interplay between obstructed atomic insulating and first-order topological phases via electron-phonon coupling (EPC) in a $d$-wave altermagnet (AM) that hosts nonrelativistic spin-split bands with zero net magnetization. By embedding a $d_{x^{2}-y^{2}}$-wave AM in a quantum spin Hall (QSH) insulator, we show that an altermagnetic order beyond a critical strength reconstructs the parent QSH state of a Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang (BHZ)-type topological insulator (TI) into an obstructed atomic insulator (OAI), characterized by nontrivial bulk polarization with quantized fractional corner charges, accompanied by characteristic in-gap boundary states, while the spin Chern number vanishes. Upon incorporating sufficiently strong EPC, the polaronic dressing reorganizes the Wannier centers and the associated effective edge topology, thereby weakening the altermagnetism-induced OAI phase and restoring the helical QSH edge modes. Further, EPC eventually drives the system into a trivial insulator. By uncovering a controllable switching mechanism between topologically distinct insulating phases in AMs, our study establishes a direct route toward phonon-tuned spintronic functionalities in unconventional magnetic platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究了在d波交替磁体中通过电子-声子耦合(EPC)调控受阻原子绝缘体与一阶拓扑相之间的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 探索交替磁体这一零净磁化、非相对论自旋劈裂平台中，如何可控地切换拓扑相，为声子调控的自旋电子学功能提供途径。
AI.method: 将d_{x^2-y^2}波交替磁体嵌入量子自旋霍尔(BHZ型)拓扑绝缘体，引入EPC，分析交替磁序强度与极化子效应对Wannier中心和边界拓扑的重构。
AI.result: 超过临界强度的交替磁序将母体QSH态重构为OAI（具有非平凡体极化、量子化分数角电荷和带内边界态，自旋陈数消失）；足够强的EPC削弱OAI相并恢复螺旋QSH边缘模，最终驱动系统进入平庸绝缘体。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了交替磁体中拓扑不同绝缘相之间的可控切换机制，为非常规磁性平台中声子调谐的自旋电子学功能提供了直接路径。

title: Active lattice percolation: an apparently new universality class of percolation transitions
summary: We investigate a class of dynamic percolation models on a lattice, in which connections are added and removed by a set of local stochastic rules. In particular, the removal of any connection that can result in one connected cluster becoming two (or more) separate clusters is strictly forbidden. These models include and are inspired by a model for local quantum error correction for a toric code studied by Chirame, et al., PRX Quantum 6, 030363 (2025), who identified a phase transition with first-order characteristics, such as bistability and a discontinuous order parameter. We show numerically that this transition is a hybrid percolation transition (HPT), having characteristics of a continuous percolation transition such as diverging critical clusters while at the same transition having discontinuities like a first-order transition. We then modify this model to be fully isotropic, showing that the HPT remains. In both of these models, the steady state on one side of the HPT is an absorbing state; by turning on additional isotropic local stochastic moves, we remove the absorbing state and strongly suppress or remove the first-order transition, leaving an apparently continuous percolation transition. Curiously, the numerically-observed percolation critical exponents do not change significantly between the models with hybrid transitions and the model with an apparently continuous transition. These exponents are significantly different from known percolation transitions, indicating that this may be a new universality class.

AI.tldr: 研究一类动态渗流模型的相变性质，发现其呈现混合渗流相变（HPT），并可能构成新的普适类。
AI.motivation: Chirame等人研究的环面码局域量子纠错模型表现出具有双稳态和不连续序参量的一阶相变特征，本文旨在深入刻画该相变本质并探究其普适性。
AI.method: 在格点上定义动态渗流模型，禁止移除会导致连通团簇分裂的连边；通过数值模拟分析相变性质；并修改模型使其完全各向同性；再引入额外各向同性局域随机移动以消除吸收态。
AI.result: 数值表明该相变是混合渗流相变（HPT），同时具有连续相变的发散临界团簇和一阶相变的不连续性；完全各向同性模型仍保留HPT；加入额外局域移动后吸收态消失，一阶相变被强烈抑制或消除，转为看似连续的渗流相变；但临界指数在不同模型间变化不大，且显著区别于已知渗流相变。
AI.conclusion: 该动态渗流模型展现混合相变特征，且其临界指数可能标志着一个新的普适类。

title: Lifshitz transition and magnetic superconductivity in flat band systems
summary: A Lifshitz transition is a class of non-symmetry-breaking transitions typically associated with metallic systems wherein the Fermi surface changes its connectivity as the chemical potential sweeps through a band extremum or a saddle point. The phenomenology naturally adapts itself to the superconducting state, where the object that reconstructs is the manifold of minimum quasiparticle energy rather than the Fermi surface. This paper concerns Lifshitz-type transitions in multi-band superconductors. Thus, we focus on the attractive Hubbard--Kondo model on the two-dimensional Lieb lattice, with classical core spins coupled to the itinerant electrons, by laying recourse to a real-space Bogoliubov--de Gennes mean-field theory and an analytic Green's function calculation. The competition between the Kondo and pairing channels yields a magnetic superconductor throughout, with $(π,π)$ order near half filling giving way to $(0,π)$ and then, at stronger Kondo coupling, to an incommensurate spiral $(0,q)$. In such a multiband superconductor hosting a flat band, we identify two inequivalent Lifshitz-type transitions. With the core spins decoupled (the Kondo coupling set to zero), the minimum energy contour deforms with chemical potential, a hole pocket about $M$ opening into a perfectly nested square at $μ=-2t$ and reconnecting into pockets about $Γ$; this nesting fixes where $(π,π)$ order sets in. At finite Kondo coupling, for certain chemical potential, the dimension of the manifold itself drops. We obtain it analytically for each magnetic order and show that only the spiral carries the minimum energy through zero, nucleating nodes and leaving a gapless magnetic superconductor, with clear signatures in the density of states and the spectral function.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维Lieb晶格上吸引Hubbard-Kondo模型中的Lifshitz型转变，揭示多带超导体中两类不等价转变及其与磁序的关系。
AI.motivation: Lifshitz转变通常与金属体系相关，其费米面连通性随化学势改变。本文旨在将这一概念推广到多带超导态，研究对象是最低准粒子能量流形的重构，并探究Kondo与配对通道竞争下的磁超导行为。
AI.method: 采用实空间Bogoliubov-de Gennes平均场理论与解析格林函数计算，在二维Lieb晶格上研究吸引Hubbard-Kondo模型，其中经典核心自旋与巡游电子耦合。通过调控化学势与Kondo耦合，分析配对通道与磁性通道的竞争。
AI.result: Kondo与配对竞争产生贯穿整个参数区的磁超导体：半填充附近为(π,π)序，随Kondo耦合增强转为(0,π)序，最终变为不可公度螺旋(0,q)序。在含平带的多带超导体中识别出两类不等价Lifshitz型转变：零Kondo耦合时，最低能量等值线随化学势形变，M点空穴口袋在μ=-2t处张开为完美嵌套方形并重连为Γ附近口袋；有限Kondo耦合下，某些化学势处流形维度本身下降。解析求得各磁序下的结果，表明仅螺旋序使最低能量过零，产生节点并形成无能隙磁超导体，在态密度与谱函数中有明显特征。
AI.conclusion: 多带超导体中Lifshitz型转变可表现为最低准粒子能量流形的重构，其维度变化与磁序类型密切相关；螺旋磁序可诱导无能隙磁超导态，为关联电子体系中超导与磁性共存提供了新视角。

title: Emergent magnetic nonanalyticity in Dirac altermagnets
summary: Symmetry has long provided the organizing principle for understanding how materials respond to external perturbations. Here we show that what is permitted by symmetry need not be what actually emerges from the underlying system, and this distinction becomes particularly consequential for symmetry-related gapless Dirac fermions such as in altermagnets. A perturbation that shifts the Dirac points drives a Lifshitz reconstruction and generates an intrinsically nonanalytic effective potential, giving rise to undiscovered singular responses. In Dirac altermagnets, this nonanalyticity acquires a magnetic manifestation through $C$-paired spin-polarized Dirac cones: breaking the pairing symmetry $C$ lifts their degeneracy and converts the associated Lifshitz reconstruction into an itinerant magnetization. As a consequence, piezomagnetism, the induction of a net magnetization by a mechanical strain, becomes nonlinear and nonanalytic, with $M\propto\mathrm{sgn}(\varepsilon)\varepsilon^2$, whereas the linear response is absent despite being allowed by symmetry. Accordingly, the leading response cannot be inferred from the conventional symmetry-based paradigm of material response built upon the cornerstones of Neumann's principle and analytic Landau expansion. First-principles calculations identify the monolayer Fe$_2$S as a candidate material realization for such singular magnetic responses. These results suggest quantum singularities as a new degree of freedom for engineering material responses.

AI.tldr: 对称性允许的响应未必实际出现；狄拉克交替磁体中Lifshitz重构产生非解析响应，导致非线性非解析压磁效应， monolayer Fe₂S 为候选材料。
AI.motivation: 传统材料响应理论基于Neumann原理与解析Landau展开，认为对称性允许的响应即可出现。作者想指出对称性允许与实际涌现之间存在根本区别，尤其是在交替磁体等具有对称性相关的无能隙狄拉克费米子体系中，这一区别具有重要后果。
AI.method: 理论分析对称性相关的狄拉克费米子（C配对自旋极化狄拉克锥），通过移动狄拉克点驱动Lifshitz重构，推导出内禀非解析有效势；结合第一性原理计算筛选候选材料。
AI.result: 破坏C配对对称性可解除简并，将Lifshitz重构转化为巡游磁化。压磁效应变为非线性非解析，M∝sgn(ε)ε²，而对称性允许的线性响应实际缺失。第一性原理计算确定单层Fe₂S为可实现该奇异磁响应的候选材料。
AI.conclusion: 材料响应不能仅由对称性推断，量子奇异性可作为调控材料响应的新自由度，挑战了以Neumann原理和解析Landau展开为基础的传统范式。

title: Complete Entanglement Structure of the Kitaev Honeycomb Spin Liquid from Exact Tensor Networks
summary: While most of the features of the Kitaev honeycomb model are already clarified from the combined ${\mathbb Z}_2$ plaquette and Majorana fermion picture, we show that retrieving the exact quantum many-body form gives a clue to fix the remaining issues on its spin liquid property. We provide an exact two-dimensional tensor network description of a full set of solutions from a random product state, by sequential quantum-number projection and Gutzwiller projection, both expressed as local matrix-product operators of dimension $D=2$. The ground and excited states share the same bond dimension yet exhibit distinct Schmidt spectra, distinguishing their area-law and volume-law entanglement. We demonstrate that the topological entanglement entropy emerges {\it for all eigenstates only after} the Gutzwiller projection onto the physical spin Hilbert space, where the gauge constraint removes exactly half of the Schmidt states. This establishes that excited states are likewise topologically ordered. We further show that there exists a projection-induced collapse of the wave function into a single gauge sector in the Parton mean-field states that is known to give a good description of the spin liquids. The demonstrations on the $S=1/2$ kagome and triangular Heisenberg models suggest that the present perspective is applied to a wider class of models hosting ${\mathbb Z}_2$ spin liquids. Our finding visualizes a bulk-boundary correspondence with the Wilson-loop characterization of topological order.

AI.tldr: 通过张量网络与量子数/Gutzwiller投影，精确描述了Kitaev蜂窝模型全部本征态，证明激发态同样具有拓扑序。
AI.motivation: Kitaev蜂窝模型虽已有Z2格点与Majorana费米子图像，但自旋液体性质仍有遗留问题，需从精确量子多体形式入手解决。
AI.method: 用维度D=2的局域矩阵乘积算符，对随机乘积态依次做量子数投影与Gutzwiller投影，构造全套解的张量网络描述。
AI.result: 基态与激发态共享相同键维但Schmidt谱不同，体现面积律与体积律纠缠；拓扑纠缠熵仅在所有本征态经Gutzwiller投影到物理自旋希尔伯特空间后才出现，规范约束恰好剔除一半Schmidt态。
AI.conclusion: 激发态同样是拓扑有序的；Parton平均场态中波函数因投影坍缩到单一规范扇区；该视角适用于kagome与三角Heisenberg等更广的Z2自旋液体模型，并可可视化体-边对应与Wilson环刻画。

title: Anisotropic Friedel oscillations and isoperimetric transport in two-dimensional free lattice Fermi seas
summary: Two physical consequences of the recent topological classification of 2d Fermi seas for free particles based on flat orbifolds $\mathbb{R}^2/Γ$ of discrete symmetry $Γ$, are explored. The first is an study of the spatial density behavior inside the mesoscopic window enclosed by the Fermi and (infinite) thermal lengths. It is shown that the single-particle density matrix exhibits a sharp directional anisotropy, encoding a real space diffraction pattern, {\it i.e.}, a Fraunhofer-like diagram of the Fermi sea, that reveals the point-group symmetries of the background lattice $Γ$ in the form of anisotropic Friedel oscillations. As examples, the special cases of the $p4m$ and $p6m$ crystallographic flat orbifolds are treated in some detail. The second physical consequence is the establishment of an explicit geometric correspondence between momentum-space packing and electrical transport. A mean-field expression for the longitudinal electrical conductivity $σ_{xx}$ as a function of the {\it isoperimetric parameter} $\cal{I}$ of the occupied orbifold domain by utilizing geometric measure theory is presented, satisfiying the scaling law $ σ_{xx} \propto 1/\sqrt{\cal{I}}$. The topological transport formula naturally incorporates the vanishing conductivity ($σ_{xx} \to 0$) of the previously described ``geometric insulators,'' promoting the isoperimetric parameter as an efficient descriptor for topological and geometric phases in conductors.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨基于平直orbifold $\mathbb{R}^2/\Gamma$ 的2d Fermi海拓扑分类的两个物理后果：实空间密度各向异性（Friedel振荡）与动量空间堆积-电输运的几何对应。
AI.motivation: 近期基于离散对称群平直orbifold的自由粒子2d Fermi海拓扑分类需要物理验证，需探索其在介观尺度密度行为与电输运中的可观测后果。
AI.method: 在Fermi长度与热长度界定的介观窗口内研究单粒子密度矩阵；利用几何测度论，建立动量空间占据orbifold域与纵向电导$\sigma_{xx}$之间的联系，引入等周参数$\cal{I}$。
AI.result: 单粒子密度矩阵呈现尖锐方向各向异性，编码Fermi海的实空间衍射图案（Fraunhofer型图样），以各向异性Friedel振荡揭示背景晶格$\Gamma$的点群对称性（详析$p4m$、$p6m$情形）。电导满足标度律$\sigma_{xx}\propto 1/\sqrt{\cal{I}}$，并自然给出"几何绝缘体"电导趋零。
AI.conclusion: 等周参数可作为导体中拓扑与几何相位的有效描述符，将动量空间堆积与电输运显式几何对应。

title: Multicatalyst reactions induce abrupt transition in a dense catalytic reaction network model
summary: We generalize the Furusawa--Kaneko model, a simple model of intracellular catalytic reaction networks, to multicatalyst reactions and analyze the generalized model using dynamical mean-field theory. In the thermodynamic and dense-network limit, we derive exact effective equations and analyze their fixed points for arbitrary degree distributions. Under nutrient-poor conditions, network heterogeneity suppresses the metabolic--starvation transition irrespective of the number of catalysts per reaction. In contrast, under nutrient-rich conditions, the bifurcation structure changes with the number of catalysts. With one catalyst per reaction, only continuous transitions occur, whereas two or more catalysts give rise to bistable phases and discontinuous transitions. The bifurcation structure also differs between two and three catalysts per reaction, with three catalysts allowing bistability between metabolic states with different cell growth rates. Our results provide a possible mechanism for bistability and abrupt switching in metabolic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文将Furusawa--Kaneko胞内催化反应网络模型推广至多催化剂反应，并用动力学平均场理论分析，揭示了网络异质性与催化剂数量对代谢-饥饿转变及双稳性的影响。
AI.motivation: 原始Furusawa--Kaneko模型仅处理单催化剂反应，而真实胞内催化反应常涉及多个催化剂，需理解多催化剂与网络异质性如何影响代谢动力学与转变行为。
AI.method: 将模型推广到多催化剂反应，在热力学极限与稠密网络极限下用动力学平均场理论推导精确有效方程，并对任意度分布求解不动点、分析分岔结构。
AI.result: 贫营养下网络异质性普遍抑制代谢-饥饿转变，与每反应催化剂数无关；富营养下分岔结构随催化剂数变化：单催化剂仅有连续转变，两或三个催化剂出现双稳相与不连续转变，且二与三催化剂情形不同，三催化剂可实现不同细胞生长率的代谢态双稳。
AI.conclusion: 结果为代谢动力学中的双稳性与突变切换提供了可能的机制解释。

title: Development and Application of a Magnetoelectric Coupling Measurement System for Strain-Mediated Effects
summary: This paper reports about development of a dynamic lock-in based magnetoelectric (ME) coupling measurement system and its application to investigate strain-mediated coupling in 0.65Pb(Mg$_{1/3}$Nb$_{2/3}$)O$_3$-0.35PbTiO$_3$/NiFe$_2$O$_4$ (PMN-PT/NFO) and CoFe$_2$O$_4$/BaTiO$_3$ (CFO/BTO) composites. The PMN-PT/NFO composite exhibits a significantly enhanced ME coefficient ($α_{\mathrm{ME}} \approx 1.85$~mV\,mm$^{-1}$\,Oe$^{-1}$) compared to CFO/BTO ($\approx 0.147$~mV\,mm$^{-1}$\,Oe$^{-1}$). The antisymmetric field dependence and $180^\circ$ phase reversal confirm the strain-driven origin of coupling in both the samples. The superior response of PMN-PT/NFO arises from the combined effect of high piezoelectric strength in PMN-PT and low magnetic anisotropy of NFO, whereas the high magnetic anisotropy of CFO and weaker piezoelectricity of BTO limit the ME output. These results highlight the decisive role of magnetic softness and piezoelectric strength in optimizing strain-mediated ME coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了基于动态锁相放大的磁电耦合测量系统，用于研究PMN-PT/NFO和CFO/BTO复合材料的应变介导磁电耦合，发现PMN-PT/NFO的磁电系数远高于CFO/BTO。
AI.motivation: 需开发灵敏的磁电耦合测量系统，并厘清压电强度与磁各向异性对复合材料应变介导磁电耦合的影响机制。
AI.method: 搭建基于动态锁相放大的磁电耦合测量系统，测量PMN-PT/NFO与CFO/BTO复合材料的磁电系数，并分析其磁场依赖性与相位特性。
AI.result: PMN-PT/NFO的磁电系数约1.85 mV·mm⁻¹·Oe⁻¹，远高于CFO/BTO的约0.147 mV·mm⁻¹·Oe⁻¹；两者的反对称场依赖及180°相位反转证实耦合源于应变驱动。
AI.conclusion: PMN-PT/NFO的优势源于PMN-PT的高压电性与NFO的低磁各向异性；磁软化程度与压电强度是优化应变介导磁电耦合的决定性因素。

title: Nonthermal nonlinear many-body excitonic dynamics in high-purity silicon
summary: We report time-resolved optical pump-terahertz third-harmonic generation spectroscopy of picosecond nonthermal many-body charge dynamics in high-purity silicon at room temperature. Although in thermal equilibrium excitons in silicon are unstable due to a lower binding energy than the thermal energy at room temperature, following pulsed non-resonant optical pumping we can identify the formation of transient excitonic states on the picosecond time scale in our high-resolution nonlinear spectroscopic measurements. In contrast to unbound electron-hole pairs, the nonthermal many-body excitonic dynamics feature a characteristic time-dependent evolution, a distinct dependence on charge density, and a nonperturbative nonlinear terahertz response.

AI.tldr: 利用时间分辨光泵浦-太赫兹三次谐波光谱，在室温高纯硅中观测到皮秒尺度非热激子态的形成。
AI.motivation: 室温下硅中激子结合能低于热能，热平衡下激子不稳定，因此研究其在非平衡条件下的瞬态存在具有意义。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨光学泵浦-太赫兹三次谐波产生光谱技术，对室温高纯硅中皮秒非热多体电荷动力学进行高分辨率非线性测量。
AI.result: 非共振光泵浦后，在皮秒时间尺度上识别到瞬态激子态的形成；与未束缚电子-空穴对相比，非热多体激子动力学表现出特征性的时间演化、对电荷密度的显著依赖以及非微扰非线性太赫兹响应。
AI.conclusion: 即使热平衡下激子不稳定，非平衡条件下仍可形成瞬态激子态，并具有独特的非线性太赫兹响应特征。

title: Nonlinearity-induced Topological Phase Transitions in One-dimensional Systems with Chiral Symmetry: A Real-Space Treatment
summary: Nonlinearity can induce topological phase transitions in periodic systems. It is hence of considerable interest to examine if such transitions persist in the absence of translational symmetry. We address this question directly in real space, using the periodic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain as a reference for understanding the effect of quasiperiodicity. How nonlinearity drives a chain towards a topological phase transition is found to depend strongly on the strength of the quasiperiodic potential. As the nonlinearity strength increases, we find that weak quasiperiodicity supports a transition from a trivial to a topological phase, whereas the intermediate regime does not have a topological phase transition. Under strong quasiperiodicity, pronounced boundary localization can develop well before a nonlinearity-induced topological transition. Our results show how nonlinearity may interplay with a quasiperiodic potential in inducing topological phase transitions and that boundary localization of nonlinear eigenstates alone may not be taken as a clear signature of topological edge states.

AI.tldr: 研究非线性与准周期势如何共同影响SSH链的拓扑相变，指出边界局域化未必是拓扑边缘态的可靠判据。
AI.motivation: 非线性可在周期系统中诱导拓扑相变，但其在缺乏平移对称性的系统中是否仍存在尚不清楚。作者以周期SSH链为参照，考察准周期性对非线性诱导拓扑相变的影响。
AI.method: 在实空间直接研究，将非线性引入含准周期势的SSH链，通过调节非线性强度与准周期势强度，分析非线性本征态的边界局域化与拓扑相变行为。
AI.result: 非线性驱动拓扑相变的方式强烈依赖准周期势强度：弱准周期性下，随非线性增强出现从平庸到拓扑相的转变；中等强度区域不存在拓扑相变；强准周期性下，在非线性诱导拓扑转变之前就已出现显著的边界局域化。
AI.conclusion: 非线性与准周期势在诱导拓扑相变中存在复杂交互作用，仅凭非线性本征态的边界局域化不能作为拓扑边缘态的明确标志。

title: Parisi's solution of the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick model from synchronous Monte Carlo dynamics
summary: Sompolinsky and Zippelius obtained Parisi's solution of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) model from the relaxational dynamics of soft spins in continuous time, by assuming a hierarchy of widely separated time scales. Here we carry out the same programme for a discrete-time dynamics in which all Ising spins are updated at once. This dynamics, synchronous Monte Carlo (SyncMC), introduces Gaussian auxiliary fields so that the spins become conditionally independent, and it samples the Boltzmann distribution exactly for any system with symmetric pairwise couplings. We show that, for any such system, the correlation and response functions of SyncMC obey an exact fluctuation-dissipation relation in discrete time in equilibrium. The dynamical mean-field equations of SyncMC for the SK model contain two terms absent in continuous-time dynamics, a self-coupling of each spin and a noise correlated through the couplings; both affect only the fast relaxation. As a result, under the same assumptions as in the Sompolinsky-Zippelius construction (widely separated time scales, and on each slow scale the same relation with a reduced ratio x, as expected in relaxation from random initial conditions), the long-time structure of SyncMC reproduces the Parisi equations, including the Parisi partial differential equation and the equation for the distribution of local fields. Equilibrium simulations with replica exchange for up to N=2048 spins exclude the replica-symmetric distribution of the actual local fields and are consistent with the Parisi solution. The function x(q) estimated from the overlap distribution, and from the response in relaxation from random configurations for up to N=4096 spins, is also consistent with Parisi's.

AI.tldr: 该论文用同步蒙特卡洛(SyncMC)离散时间动力学重现了SK模型的Parisi解，并在数值模拟中验证了与Parisi解的一致性。
AI.motivation: Sompolinsky和Zippelius曾从软自旋弛豫动力学得到Parisi解，本文希望将类似方案推广到所有Ising自旋同时更新的离散时间动力学中，以验证Parisi解的普适性。
AI.method: 引入高斯辅助场使自旋条件独立，构造同步蒙特卡洛(SyncMC)动力学；证明其精确采样玻尔兹曼分布并满足离散时间平衡涨落-耗散关系；推导SK模型的动力学平均场方程，并在慢时间尺度假设下与Parisi方程对比；再用replica exchange方法进行数值模拟。
AI.result: SyncMC的动力学平均场方程比连续时间多出自耦合项与通过耦合关联的噪声项，但仅影响快弛豫；在宽分离时间尺度假设下，其长时间结构重现Parisi方程(包括Parisi偏微分方程和局域场分布方程)。N=2048的平衡模拟排除了replica-symmetric局域场分布，与Parisi解一致；由overlap分布和随机初态弛豫响应估计的x(q)在N=4096时也与Parisi结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 离散时间同步动力学同样能导出Parisi解，表明Parisi解不依赖于连续时间构造，且在数值上得到进一步支持。

title: The Hidden Cost of Two-Dimensional TEM Reconstruction of Magnetic Nanoparticle Morphology
summary: Conventional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) records two-dimensional (2D) projections of three-dimensional (3D) objects, complicating the inference of nanoparticle morphology. This limitation is investigated for quasi-spherical iron oxide nanoparticles (IONPs) imaged after deposition on a TEM grid and after cellular internalization and immobilization in resin. A statistical inverse-reconstruction method is developed in which synthetic 3D particle populations are randomly oriented, projected onto a TEM-like plane, and compared with the experimental equivalent-diameter and axial-ratio distributions. Models of increasing geometrical complexity are considered, from monodisperse prolate spheroids to size- and shape-polydisperse prolate populations and triaxial ellipsoids. Size polydispersity is required to reproduce the projected equivalent-diameter distribution, whereas relaxing axial symmetry through a triaxial description enables simultaneous reproduction of the size and axial-ratio distributions. The inferred population represents a statistically compatible 3D morphology rather than a unique particle-by-particle reconstruction. Its physical relevance is assessed through a macrospin model incorporating the corresponding shape-anisotropy contributions. Application to magnetic fluid hyperthermia reveals a pronounced sensitivity of the predicted heating response to particle geometry and polydispersity. The approach provides a general framework for connecting conventional TEM measurements with morphology-dependent properties of nanoparticle ensembles.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种统计逆重建方法，从传统TEM二维投影推断准球形氧化铁纳米颗粒的三维形貌，并用于磁热疗性能预测。
AI.motivation: 传统TEM仅记录三维物体的二维投影，导致纳米颗粒形貌推断困难，尤其对沉积在载网上或细胞内树脂包埋后的准球形氧化铁纳米颗粒。
AI.method: 构建统计逆重建：将合成三维颗粒群体随机取向并投影到类TEM平面，与实验的等效直径和轴比分布比较；模型从单分散长椭球逐步扩展到尺寸/形状多分散长椭球群体及三轴椭球。
AI.result: 尺寸多分散性可复现投影等效直径分布；引入三轴描述放松轴对称后可同时复现尺寸与轴比分布。推断结果为统计兼容的三维形貌而非唯一逐颗粒重建。
AI.conclusion: 结合形状各向异性的宏自旋模型验证了物理相关性，磁流体热疗预测对颗粒几何与多分散性高度敏感该框架可连接传统TEM测量与纳米颗粒集合体的形貌依赖性质。

title: Multi-bit Ferroelectric-NAND for High-throughput Massive Database Search
summary: The growing demand for large-scale database search in data-intensive applications, ranging from proteomics to autonomous systems, has exposed fundamental limitations in von Neumann architectures due to memory bandwidth and energy constraints. Hyperdimensional (HD) computing offers a robust and parallelizable framework for such tasks, but its practical implementation remains challenged by high memory demands. Ultra-high-density, energy-efficient ferroelectric NAND (FE-NAND) memory provides a potential solution by enabling in-situ computation. We fabricate quad-level FE-NAND strings with wide memory windows, disturb resilience, and robust retention. Using these planar FE-NAND strings as building blocks, we experimentally demonstrate in-situ multi-level cell (MLC) dot product operations at the single-cell level and, using experimentally calibrated physics-based simulations, demonstrate Hamming similarity calculations between reference and query hypervectors (HV). This platform leverages the inherent error tolerance of HD computing to achieve >90% search accuracy even at high logic levels (TLC, QLC). When benchmarked on Open Modification Search (OMS) tasks in proteomics with TB-scale datasets, our system shows nearly 1,000x speedup and over 10,000x energy efficiency improvement compared to incumbent solutions. These results establish FE-NAND as a viable in-storage compute architecture for large-scale, high-dimensional data processing.

AI.tldr: 提出铁电NAND（FE-NAND）作为存内计算架构，实验验证其支持超维计算的原位点积与汉明相似度计算，在蛋白质组学大规模检索任务中实现近1000倍加速和超10000倍能效提升。
AI.motivation: 数据密集型应用（如蛋白质组学、自主系统）对大规模数据库检索需求增长，冯·诺依曼架构受内存带宽与能耗限制。超维（HD）计算适合此类任务，但高内存需求阻碍其实际落地，因此需要高密度、高能效且可原位计算的存储方案。
AI.method: 制备四层级（QLC）平面FE-NAND串，具备宽存储窗口、抗扰动性和可靠保持性；以单胞级实验演示多层级（MLC）点积操作，并通过基于实验校准的物理仿真演示参考与查询超向量之间的汉明相似度计算；利用HD计算的容错性支持高层级逻辑（TLC、QLC）。
AI.result: 即便在高层级逻辑下仍可实现>90%检索准确率；在TB级蛋白质组学开放修饰检索（OMS）任务上，相比现有方案实现近1000倍加速和超10000倍能效提升。
AI.conclusion: FE-NAND可作为面向大规模高维数据处理的可行存内计算架构。

title: Confined Riesz gas: From Newtonian Dynamics to Emergent Hydrodynamics
summary: We investigate the real-time dynamics of the Riesz gas (RG), a paradigmatic system of particles with power-law interactions that encapsulates several many-body interacting classical systems. While the equilibrium properties of the system have been extensively studied the connection between microscopic dynamics, macroscopic evolution and thermalization has remained largely unexplored. Combining extensive large-scale Newtonian simulations with a hydrodynamic framework formulated in terms of three coarse grained fields -- density, velocity, and temperature -- we establish a direct and quantitative correspondence between the two descriptions. The hydrodynamic theory incorporates two phenomenological transport coefficients, the bulk viscosity $ξ$ and thermal conductivity $κ$, which encode dissipative effects at a macroscopic level. By analyzing representative classes of initial conditions, such as dome-like and Newton-cradle-type profiles, we find excellent agreement between microscopic and hydrodynamic evolution over a broad range of timescales, starting from relatively early all the way up to times at which steady state is attained. Notably, this agreement persists across a substantial window of $ξ$ and $κ$, demonstrating the robustness of the emergent hydrodynamic description. Our results provide a systematic validation of hydrodynamics in the RG and establish a concrete bridge between Newtonian dynamics and continuum theories in systems with power-law interactions, starting from first principles.

AI.tldr: 研究Riesz气体的实时动力学，通过大规模模拟与流体力学理论结合，建立了微观与宏观描述的定量对应关系。
AI.motivation: Riesz气体的平衡性质已被广泛研究，但微观动力学、宏观演化与热化之间的联系尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 结合大规模牛顿力学模拟与基于密度、速度、温度三个粗粒化场的流体力学框架，理论中引入体粘滞系数ξ和热导率κ两个唯象输运系数。
AI.result: 对圆顶型与牛顿摆型等代表性初始条件，在从早期直到稳态的广泛时间尺度上，微观演化与流体力学演化高度吻合，且在较大ξ和κ范围内保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 系统验证了Riesz气体中流体力学的有效性，从第一性原理出发建立了幂律相互作用系统中牛顿动力学与连续介质理论之间的桥梁。

title: Wavelength-Dependent Photoluminescence Mapping of Depth-Dependent Degradation Under Thermal Stress in Phenethylammonium Tetrafluoroborate Treated Perovskite Solar Cells
summary: Studying real-time degradation in perovskite semiconductors remains an important challenge. Conventional methods often cannot separate interfacial and bulk processes or rely on destructive analysis. Here, we demonstrate multiwavelength excitation photoluminescence (PL) as a nondestructive approach to distinguish interface- and bulk-dominated recombination losses. Using phenethylammonium tetrafluoroborate (PEABF4) treatment as a model, we use PL to show that PEABF4 passivates the electron transport layer (ETL)/perovskite interface, reducing interfacial recombination losses from fullerene deposition. However, upon thermal aging, PEABF4-treated stacks degrade more rapidly, with recombination losses broadening from the ETL/perovskite interface into the absorber. Diffusion-recombination simulations support interpreting excitation-wavelength-dependent PL decay signatures consistent with changes in surface recombination velocity and bulk lifetime, providing a framework for depth-sensitive comparisons during aging. Collectively, these results further establish multiwavelength excitation PL as a platform for studying recombination losses during aging of perovskite films.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多波长激发光致发光(PL)方法，可无损区分钙钛矿半导体中界面与体相复合损失，并以PEABF4处理为例研究热老化下的降解过程。
AI.motivation: 研究钙钛矿半导体实时降解是重要挑战：传统方法难以区分界面与体相过程，且往往依赖破坏性分析。
AI.method: 采用多波长激发PL作为无损手段：以PEABF4处理为模型，通过不同激发波长的PL衰减特征，结合扩散-复合模拟，区分表面复合速度与体寿命的变化。
AI.result: PEABF4可钝化ETL/钙钛矿界面，减少来自富勒烯沉积的界面复合损失；但热老化后，PEABF4处理样品降解更快，复合损失从ETL/钙钛矿界面扩展至吸收层体相。
AI.conclusion: 多波长激发PL可作为研究钙钛矿薄膜老化过程中复合损失的有效平台，实现深度敏感的对比分析。

title: Pairing order and condensate fraction across the BCS-BEC crossover in the two-dimensional attractive Hubbard model
summary: We report a systematic study of the superconducting ground state in the two-dimensional attractive Hubbard model, employing the {\it numerically exact} auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo method. We focus primarily on the pairing order and condensate fraction across the BCS-BEC crossover. Our numerical calculations cover a broad and physically relevant parameter regime, with the interaction strength $U/t=2\sim 12$ (where $t$ is the nearest-neighbor hopping amplitude) and fermion density $n=0.25\sim 1.0$. We systematically characterize the dependence of the pairing order and condensate fraction on both the interaction strength and fermion density, and perform finite-size extrapolations to obtain their thermodynamic-limit values. As complementary quantities, we also provide high-precision numerical results for the double occupancy and total energy. Furthermore, we investigate the effects of next-nearest-neighbor hopping on the superconducting properties of the model. Our results offer a comprehensive set of unbiased numerical data for the attractive Hubbard model, establishing quantitative benchmarks for understanding superconductivity across the BCS-BEC crossover and for validating future theoretical and numerical approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文用数值精确的辅助场量子蒙特卡洛方法系统研究二维吸引哈伯德模型的超导基态，重点考察BCS-BEC渡越中的配对序与凝聚体分数，并提供无偏数值基准。
AI.motivation: 理解二维吸引哈伯德模型中BCS-BEC渡越的超导基态需要无偏、系统的数值数据，但此前缺乏覆盖广泛参数区间的高精度基准结果。
AI.method: 采用数值精确的辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（AFQMC）方法，参数覆盖相互作用强度U/t=2~12、费米子密度n=0.25~1.0，并进行有限尺寸外推以获得热力学极限值，同时考察次近邻跃迁的影响。
AI.result: 系统刻画了配对序和凝聚体分数对相互作用强度与费米子密度的依赖关系，给出其热力学极限值，并提供双占据数和总能量的高精度结果，以及次近邻跃迁对超导性质的影响。
AI.conclusion: 结果为吸引哈伯德模型提供了一套全面的无偏数值数据，为理解BCS-BEC渡越中的超导性及验证未来理论与数值方法建立了定量基准。

title: From Nested Soliton Crystals to Skyrmion Crystals in Chiral Magnets
summary: We perform an exhaustive study of the parameter space of the chiral magnetic model with a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, an in-plane anisotropy term and an out-of-plane Zeeman magnetic field. We map out the phase diagram for the model and find a chiral soliton lattice hosted on a chiral soliton lattice as the ground state in a particular corner of the phase diagram. There is a smooth crossover, as opposed to a phase transition, to the skyrmion crystal lattice phase. Finally, we also discover excited composite soliton states such as an anti-skyrmion coexisting with a bimeron or an anti-bimeron.

AI.tldr: 系统研究了含Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用、面内各向异性和面外Zeeman磁场的手性磁模型相图，发现嵌套手性孤子晶格基态、到skyrmion晶格的平滑过渡以及复合孤子激发态。
AI.motivation: 全面探索该手性磁模型参数空间，揭示新奇的磁基态与激发态。
AI.method: 对含DM相互作用、面内各向异性和面外Zeeman磁场的手性磁模型进行详尽参数空间扫描，绘制相图。
AI.result: 在相图特定区域发现手性孤子晶格上嵌套手性孤子晶格的基态；向skyrmion晶格相为平滑过渡而非相变；发现反skyrmion与bimeron或反bimeron共存的复合孤子激发态。
AI.conclusion: 该模型展现出丰富的拓扑磁结构，包括嵌套孤子晶格和复合孤子激发态。

title: Site-Specific Orbital Symmetry Breaking in Epitaxial Graphene on Silicon Carbide
comment: 23 pages (main text), 3 main figures; includes Supporting Information
summary: The epitaxial graphene grown on SiC interface has been the subject of tremendous research efforts to control its electronic transport properties in the quest for graphene electronic applications. The electronic structure of the epitaxial graphene buffer layer on SiC(0001) is investigated at the atomic scale using monochromated electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) in an aberration-corrected scanning transmission electron microscope (STEM). The C $K$-edge reveals spectral fine structures distinctly different from free-standing graphene layer, providing direct experimental evidence of a modified bonding environment. Ab initio calculations providing a site-resolved probe of orbital character to elucidate the origin of these spectral features: covalent bonding between one-quarter of the buffer-layer carbon atoms and the substrate silicon atoms induces partial $\mathrm{sp}^3$ hybridization, quenching the out-of-plane $π$ states and disrupting $π$-conjugation across the interfacial layer. Substrate-imposed symmetry breaking further lifts the in-plane orbital degeneracy. This orbital-engineering framework, rooted in $π$-state quenching and site-specific symmetry breaking, establishes a quantitative basis for tailoring graphene-substrate interfaces toward next-generation low-energy transistor applications.

AI.tldr: 通过单色化EELS在原子尺度研究SiC(0001)上外延石墨烯缓冲层的电子结构，结合从头算计算揭示其键合与轨道杂化机制。
AI.motivation: 为控制外延石墨烯的电子输运性质，需在原子尺度理解SiC(0001)上缓冲层的电子结构，尤其是其与自由石墨烯的差异来源。
AI.method: 在像差校正STEM中使用单色化EELS测量C K-edge精细结构，并用从头算计算进行轨道称位分辨分析。
AI.result: C K-edge精细结构与自由石墨烯明显不同，直接证明键合环境改变；四分之一缓冲层碳与衬底硅共价键合导致部分sp3杂化，猝灭面外π态并破坏界面层π共轭，衬底引起的对称破缺进一步解除面内轨道简并。
AI.conclusion: 以π态猝灭和位点特异对称破缺为核心的轨道工程框架，为定制石墨烯-衬底界面及下一代低能耗晶体管应用提供定量基础。

title: Dynamical Valence Fluctuations and Magnetic Anisotropy in Sm(Co,Cu)$_5$
summary: The magnetic properties of Sm-based intermetallics are governed by a delicate interplay between localized $4f$ states, exchange interactions, and valence fluctuations, yet the role of dynamical $4f$ correlations remains poorly understood. Here we investigate the electronic structure and magnetic anisotropy of SmCo$_5$ and SmCu$_5$ using self-consistent DFT+$U$(ED), which explicitly treats dynamical fluctuations of the Sm $4f$ shell. We find that SmCo$_5$ exhibits pronounced Sm$^{2+}$--Sm$^{3+}$ valence fluctuations, with the $4f$ ground state dominated by $f^5$ and $f^6$ configurations. The resulting dynamical $4f$ correlations yield near compensation of the Sm spin and orbital moments and provide a quantitative description of the electronic structure, magnetic moments, and large uniaxial magnetic anisotropy of SmCo$_5$. Upon replacing Co with Cu, the balance shifts toward the $f^6$ configuration, with substantial changes in the Sm spin and orbital moments. In SmCu$_5$, this evolution of the $4f$ configuration is accompanied by a pronounced reduction of both the total magnetic moment and magnetic anisotropy. These results demonstrate that dynamical $4f$ valence fluctuations are essential for understanding the contrasting magnetic properties of SmCo$_5$ and SmCu$_5$ and provide a microscopic framework for describing magnetic anisotropy upon Co to Cu substitution in Sm(Co,Cu)$_5$.

AI.tldr: 采用DFT+U(ED)方法研究SmCo₅和SmCu₅中Sm 4f动态价态涨落对磁性的影响，发现在SmCo₅中Sm²⁺/Sm³⁺涨落导致自旋与轨道矩近补偿，而Cu替代使体系向f⁶构型移动，磁矩与磁各向异性显著减弱。
AI.motivation: Sm基金属间化合物的磁性由局域4f态、交换相互作用和价态涨落的微妙平衡决定，但动态4f关联的作用尚不清楚。作者希望阐明其在磁各向异性中的角色，特别是在Co被Cu替代时的变化机制。
AI.method: 使用自洽DFT+U(ED)方法，显式处理Sm 4f壳层的动态涨落，计算SmCo₅和SmCu₅的电子结构与磁各向异性，并比较Co→Cu替代后4f构型、自旋/轨道矩与磁各向异性的变化。
AI.result: SmCo₅表现出明显的Sm²⁺–Sm³⁺价态涨落，4f基态以f⁵和f⁶构型为主；动态4f关联使Sm自旋矩与轨道矩近补偿，并能定量描述其电子结构、磁矩和大的单轴磁各向异性。SmCu₅中平衡移向f⁶构型，自旋与轨道矩发生显著变化，总磁矩与磁各向异性大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 动态4f价态涨落是理解SmCo₅与SmCu₅磁性差异的关键，并为描述Sm(Co,Cu)₅中Co→Cu替代引起的磁各向异性变化提供了微观框架。

title: Radio-frequency electron cascade in semiconductor quantum dots
summary: Electron cotunneling in semiconductor quantum dots is a higher-order tunneling mechanism that connects initial and final charge states through energetically inaccessible virtual intermediate configurations. In quantum-dot arrays, such processes can produce simultaneous charge motion across multiple tunnel junctions and enable transitions that would otherwise be suppressed by Coulomb blockade. Here, building on an earlier proof-of-principle demonstration, we investigate radio-frequency (rf)-driven correlated cotunneling and its application to dispersive quantum-dot readout. Using both theoretical modeling and experimental measurements in two different foundry-fabricated silicon devices, we show that an external rf drive can induce correlated cyclic single-electron transitions, resulting in enhanced charge-polarization of the system. We develop a general theoretical framework for rf electron-cascade readout, which exploits cotunneling events in quantum-dot systems with three or more dots to produce a relative signal enhancement, and extend its experimental demonstration to a gate-sensed device architecture. Our results establish the operating principles of rf electron-cascade readout and provide a route to increased dispersive readout fidelity in semiconductor quantum computing architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究射频驱动的相关共隧穿，将共隧穿机制用于色散量子点读出，建立“rf电子级联读出”理论框架，并在两种硅器件中实验验证信号增强与门感测架构扩展。
AI.motivation: 共隧穿是连接初末电荷态的高阶隧穿过程，可绕过库仑阻塞实现多结同时电荷转移。此前仅有原理验证，缺少rf驱动下相关共隧穿的系统理论与在器件架构中的读出应用。
AI.method: 结合理论建模与两种代工制备硅器件的实验测量，施加外部rf驱动，研究三个及以上量子点体系中相关循环单电子跃迁及其电荷极化增强效应，并发展通用的rf电子级联读出理论框架。
AI.result: rf驱动可诱导相关循环单电子跃迁，增强系统电荷极化；在多于三个量子点的体系中利用共隧穿事件获得相对信号增强；实验演示从原架构扩展到门感测器件架构。
AI.conclusion: 确立了rf电子级联读出的工作原理，为提升半导体量子计算架构中色散读出保真度提供了途径。

title: Interacting quantum criticality with U(1) symmetry breaking in 1+1 dimensions
summary: The Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner theorem motivates the expectation that continuous symmetries remain unbroken in one-dimensional quantum ground states. Here, contrary to this expectation, we demonstrate the spontaneous breaking of U(1) spin-rotation symmetry and the emergence of an interacting quantum critical point in lattice spin-$1/2$ and spin-$1$ chains. Using subsystem Binder scaling, we locate the critical point and determine the correlation-length critical exponent as $ν= 0.60 \pm 0.02$, distinct from the Gaussian value $0.5$ but consistent with the perturbative renormalization-group prediction. We further analyze the finite-size scaling of the lowest neutral excitation gap and obtain the dynamical critical exponent $z=1.986 \pm 0.005$. The result $z < 2$ is incompatible with microscopic realizations of this critical theory by frustration-free models, implying a mechanism for continuous symmetry breaking in one-dimensional quantum ground states distinct from frustration freeness.

AI.tldr: 在一维自旋链中观察到U(1)连续对称性自发破缺及相互作用量子临界点，其临界指数偏离高斯值。
AI.motivation: Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner定理通常被认为禁止一维量子基态中连续对称性自发破缺，本文试图挑战这一预期。
AI.method: 使用子系统Binder标度定位临界点，确定关联长度临界指数；分析最低中性激发gap的有限尺度标度得到动力学临界指数。
AI.result: 关联长度临界指数ν=0.60±0.02，不同于高斯值0.5但符合微扰重整化群预测；动力学临界指数z=1.986±0.005，且z<2与无阻挫模型不符。
AI.conclusion: 一维量子基态中连续对称性破缺的机制与无阻挫性（frustration freeness）不同。

title: Quantitative near-atomic-resolution oxidation-state mapping in complex oxide heterostructures by electron energy-loss spectroscopy
summary: We present a theoretical framework for quantitative oxidation state mapping of transition-metal and rare-earth elements from near-atomic-resolution electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS) in complex oxide heterostructures. The total inelastic differential cross section of transition-metal L$_{2,3}$ and rare-earth M$_{4,5}$ edges is calculated by combining the relaxed Dirac-Hartree-Fock ionization cross section with ligand-field multiplet theory for the discrete transitions. We apply the approach to two correlated-oxide heterostructures, La$_{0.67}$Sr$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$/LaCr$_{0.2}$Mn$_{0.2}$Fe$_{0.2}$Co$_{0.2}$Ni$_{0.2}$O$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ and NdNiO$_3$/La$_{0.67}$Sr$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$/NdGaO$_3$, which include a wide range of transition-metal and rare-earth elements with overlapping features. The method resolves the oxidation states of Cr, Mn, Fe and Co and identifies the Ni contribution within the LaCr$_{0.2}$Mn$_{0.2}$Fe$_{0.2}$Co$_{0.2}$Ni$_{0.2}$O$_3$ layer at near-atomic resolution. We find predominantly Co$^{2+}$ together with mixed Mn$^{2+}$/Mn$^{3+}$/Mn$^{4+}$ character, indicating site-specific valence redistribution within the layer. We also separate overlapping spectral features, such as La-M$_{4,5}$ and Ni-L$_{2,3}$ edges in the NdNiO$_3$/La$_{0.67}$Sr$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$/NdGaO$_3$ heterostructure, thereby recovering the intrinsic Ni-L$_{2,3}$ excitation spectrum. We find that the effective Ni valence in NdNiO$_3$ deviates from the simple ionic picture. More broadly, this work establishes a generic method for quantitative valence mapping from near-atomic-resolution EELS, applicable to a wide range of experimental conditions for the study of local electronic structure of complex oxides.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个理论框架，将近原子分辨EELS与弛豫Dirac-Hartree-Fock电离截面及配体场多重态理论结合，实现复杂氧化物异质结中过渡金属和稀土元素氧化态定量映射。
AI.motivation: 复杂氧化物异质结中多种过渡金属和稀土元素谱线重叠，传统方法难以在近原子分辨下定量分辨氧化态，因此需要一种通用的定量价态映射方法。
AI.method: 通过将弛豫Dirac-Hartree-Fock电离截面与配体场多重态理论结合，计算过渡金属L2,3和稀土M4,5边的总非弹性微分截面；应用于LSMO/LCMFCNO/STO和NdNiO3/LSMO/NGO两种异质结。
AI.result: 方法成功分辨Cr、Mn、Fe、Co的氧化态并识别Ni贡献；发现Co2+为主并伴随Mn2+/Mn3+/Mn4+混合，表明层内位点特异性价态重分布；分离La-M4,5与Ni-L2,3重叠谱，恢复本征Ni-L2,3谱，发现NdNiO3中Ni有效价态偏离简单离子图像。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了从近原子分辨EELS进行定量价态映射的通用方法，适用于研究复杂氧化物局域电子结构的广泛实验条件。

title: Phenomenon-first problem formulation with language models in metal-organic frameworks
summary: Here we introduce a phenomenon-first framework for materials discovery in which an LLM receives separate descriptions of guest physics, host capabilities and operating context and proposes an unusual qualitative behavior with its mechanism, distinguishing signature and falsifier. Across 80 guest-host combinations in metal-organic frameworks, the model generated 57 proposals that were frozen before evaluation or materials selection; assessment identified nine computationally tractable candidates. In a repeat and guest-only baseline, structured formulation reproducibly broadened mechanistic exploration: the original and repeat runs each covered 21 broad mechanism families versus eight for guest-only formulation despite fewer proposals. From the original run, MC-010 yielded reproducible hydration-driven reorientation of retained ethanol in experimentally reported MOFs, while MC-015 yielded a quantum-corrected reversal of H$_2$ adsorption-region preference relative to the matched classical description. These results show how structured LLM reasoning can move upstream from executing supplied objectives toward prospectively formulating qualitative materials phenomena.

AI.tldr: 提出"现象优先"框架，让LLM基于客体物理、主体能力与操作情境的分离描述，自主构想定性材料现象并给出机制、特征信号与证伪方案，在MOF中发现9个可行候选。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM用于材料发现多停留在执行既定目标，缺乏前瞻性地提出定性新现象的能力，需要将LLM推理上移，从"执行任务"转向"构想现象"。
AI.method: 将问题拆为三部分独立描述：客体物理、主体（宿主）能力、操作情境；让LLM提出异常定性行为，并附机制、判别特征与证伪条件。在80个MOF客体-主体组合上测试，生成提案先冻结再评估；并设置重复实验与仅给客体的基线对照，比较机制族覆盖广度。
AI.result: 80个组合中生成57个提案，冻结后评估识别出9个计算可行候选。原始与重复运行各覆盖21个宽泛机制族，而仅客体基线仅8个。MC-010在实验已报道MOF中实现可复现的水合驱动保留乙醇再取向；MC-015相对经典描述给出量子修正后H2吸附区域偏好的反转。
AI.conclusion: 结构化LLM推理可前瞻性地构想定性材料现象，而非仅执行给定目标，展示了推动材料发现上游创新的潜力。

title: Strong metamagnetic switching and anisotropic magnetotransport in the distorted kagome magnet Tb6Ti4Al43
summary: We report a comprehensive investigation of the magnetic, electrical, and thermodynamic properties of single crystalline Tb6Ti4Al43, in which Tb atoms form a distorted kagome lattice embedded within a complex Ti-Al framework. Tb6Ti4Al43 exhibits pronounced magnetic anisotropy and antiferromagnetic ordering at approximately 19 K. For magnetic field applied along the c-axis, a strong metamagnetic switching is observed, accompanied by a clear asymmetric hysteresis at low temperatures, while for field applied along the ab plane, a spin-flop transition is observed. The effect of field induced magnetic states is strongly reflected in magnetotransport measurements, giving rise to pronounced anomalies in magnetoresistance and an anomalous Hall contribution. A significant intrinsic contribution to the anomalous Hall conductivity is observed, highlighting the Berry curvature effects arising from the system's momentum-space topology. Our results highlight the interplay of spin, charge, and lattice degrees of freedom in Tb6Ti4Al43 and establish this distorted kagome antiferromagnet as a promising platform for field-tunable multifunctional behaviour, including electrically readable magnetic switching, spin manipulation, and magneto-mechanical functionalities.

AI.tldr: 本研究报道了畸变kagome反铁磁体Tb6Ti4Al43单晶的磁性、电输运与热力学性质，揭示了其强磁各向异性、磁场诱导的磁转变及显著的异常霍尔效应。
AI.motivation: Tb原子在Ti-Al骨架中形成畸变kagome晶格，这类体系可能展现自旋、电荷与晶格自由度的耦合，是探索磁场可调控多功能行为的潜在平台，故需系统研究其磁、电、热性质。
AI.method: 对Tb6Ti4Al43单晶进行磁性、电输运和热力学测量；分别沿c轴和ab面施加磁场，观测磁化行为，并结合磁输运（磁电阻、异常霍尔效应）分析。
AI.result: 该材料在约19 K发生反铁磁有序，具有强磁各向异性。沿c轴加场出现强metamagnetic切换及低温下明显的不对称磁滞；沿ab面加场出现spin-flop转变。磁场诱导磁态在磁输运中引发磁电阻异常和异常霍尔贡献，并观测到显著的内禀异常霍尔电导，源于动量空间拓扑引起的Berry曲率效应。
AI.conclusion: Tb6Ti4Al43体现了自旋、电荷与晶格自由度的相互作用，是一种有前景的磁场可调多功能材料平台，可用于电学可读磁开关、自旋操控及磁-机械功能。

title: Fragmented and symmetry-restored condensates in a three-site Bose ring: exchange versus umklapp
summary: We study $N$ bosons on a three-site ring with nearest-neighbour hopping, density-assisted hopping of the opposite sign, and an on-site interaction, written equivalently as three momentum modes $q=0,\pm1$ with a channel-dependent quartic vertex. As the density-assisted term grows it inverts the band, and exact diagonalisation up to $N=400$ shows a first-order ground-state transition from the $q=0$ condensate to a state with $\avg{n_{+1}}=\avg{n_{-1}}\simeq N/2$; the avoided-crossing gap closes faster than exponentially with $N$. In its symmetric eigenstates this state is fragmented in the Penrose-Onsager sense, and at leading order in $N$ it has the energy of a Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) standing wave, as expected for a few-mode mean-field system. We distinguish two cases by switching off umklapp scattering, which is available because $2\cdot(+1)\equiv-1$ on three sites, and by varying the on-site interaction. Without umklapp, $n_{+1}-n_{-1}$ is conserved, the eigenstates form a rotor tower whose lowest member is a fragmented Fock state, and the transition leads to fragmentation exactly when the $\pm1$ interaction is attractive, as predicted by Nozières' exchange argument with the sign of the interaction reversed; otherwise the system forms a single current-carrying condensate. With umklapp, the standing wave is pinned to three positions, the three momentum sectors become degenerate exponentially in $N$, and coherent admixture of the $q=0$ mode stabilises the standing wave over a wider range; the exact ground state is then a number-squeezed, momentum-projected standing-wave condensate rather than a robustly fragmented state.

AI.tldr: 研究三格点环上的 N 个玻色子，密度辅助跃迁反转能带并诱发从 q=0 凝聚体到碎裂态的一阶相变，并区分 umklapp 散射开/关两种情况。
AI.motivation: 探究密度辅助跃迁如何反转能带、改变玻色子基态，并厘清碎裂（fragmentation）与 stand wave、umklapp 散射及相互作用符号之间的关系。
AI.method: 将三格点环映射为 q=0,±1 三个动量模式；数值上对最多 N=400 做精确对角化，理论上与 Gross-Pitaevskii 平均场和 Nozières 交换论证比较，并通过关闭 umklapp 散射、改变在位相互作用来区分情形。
AI.result: 随密度辅助项增强，基态从 q=0 凝聚体一阶转变为 ⟨n+1⟩=⟨n-1⟩≈N/2 的态，避免交叉能隙随 N 以超指数速度闭合；对称本征态在 Penrose-Onsager 意义下碎裂，领头阶能量等于 GP 驻波。无 umklapp 时 n+1-n-1 守恒、本征态构成转子塔，且仅在 ±1 相互作用为吸引时（Nozières 交换论证反向符号）发生碎裂，否则形成单载流凝聚体。有 umklapp 时驻波被钉扎在三格点，三个动量扇区随 N 指数简并，q=0 模式混入使驻波更稳定，基态为数压缩、动量投影的驻波凝聚体而非稳健碎裂态。
AI.conclusion: 该模型展示了密度辅助跃迁驱动的能带反转与一阶相变，碎裂与否由 umklapp 散射和相互作用符号控制；有 umklapp 时基态是数压缩的动量投影驻波凝聚体，而非稳健碎裂态。

title: Identification and Structural Decomposition of Hidden Defect Configurations: A Case Study of Charged Oxygen Divacancies in HfO$_2$
summary: Extensive configurational searches have revealed hidden defect structures in crystalline compounds, yet how their local bonding arrangements modify the surrounding atomic environment remains less well understood. We examine this question in hafnium oxide (HfO$_2$), which hosts energetically competing monoclinic (M), tetragonal (T), and polar orthorhombic (PO) polymorphs. For the $c$-axis oxygen-divacancy complex ($T_c$), a local-distortion search with density-functional theory (DFT) relaxation under tetragonal-lattice confinement identifies a hidden family of low-energy configurations ($T_c^{*}$). For the fully charged complex ($2\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{O}}^{2+}$), structural decomposition using Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) descriptors reveals mixed M-, T-, and PO-like character, supported by independent analyses of Hf coordination and bond geometry. The idealized $T_c$ reference connects barrierlessly to the lowest-energy mixed-motif $T_c^{*}$ configuration, lowering the energy by $18.4$ meV/f.u. within the confined landscape. After releasing the lattice constraint, we compare transformation pathways to M and PO using solid-state nudged elastic band calculations with cell-relaxed endpoints. The respective barriers increase from $6.9$ and $10.1$ meV/f.u. for the idealized reference to $26.9$ and $15.3$ meV/f.u. for the $T_c^{*}$-derived structure. The larger increase for M makes PO, rather than M, the lower-barrier branch. This case study shows how structural decomposition connects hidden defect configurations with changes in the surrounding atomic environment and kinetic branching between competing polymorphs.

AI.tldr: 本文用DFT局域畸变搜索与SOAP结构分解研究HfO₂中c轴氧双空位复合体的隐藏构型，揭示其对周围原子环境与多晶型相变动力学分支的影响。
AI.motivation: 已有研究通过构型搜索发现了晶体中的隐藏缺陷结构，但这些缺陷的局域键合如何改变周围原子环境仍不清楚。HfO₂存在能量上相互竞争的M、T、PO三种多晶型，是研究该问题的理想体系。
AI.method: 在四方晶格约束下进行DFT弛豫的局域畸变搜索，识别低能隐藏构型家族Tc*；用SOAP描述符对全电荷复合体2VO²⁺进行结构分解，辅以Hf配位与键几何分析；释放晶格约束后用固态NEB（端点含晶胞弛豫）比较向M和PO的相变路径与势垒。
AI.result: SOAP分解显示2VO²⁺具有M、T、PO混合特征。理想Tc参考构型无势垒连接至最低能混合基元Tc*，能量降低18.4 meV/f.u.。释放约束后，Tc*向M和PO的势垒分别由理想参考的6.9和10.1 meV/f.u.升至26.9和15.3 meV/f.u.，M增幅更大，使PO成为低势垒分支。
