title: Unraveling Fermi liquid charge and heat transport in RuO$_{2}$
comment: main: 12 pages, 5 figures; supplement: 6 pages, 6 figures
summary: RuO$_2$ is a multi-orbital Fermi liquid for which an array of complementary experimental measurements has recently become available, making it a stringent testbed for quantitative many-body electronic structure theory. Using realistic dynamical mean-field calculations, we compute the spectroscopic and transport properties of RuO$_2$ in the paramagnetic state. We identify RuO$_2$ as a moderately correlated Fermi liquid and obtain (semi-)quantitative agreement with experiment for its optical conductivity, electrical resistivity, and thermopower. This broad agreement across complementary observables establishes a ``precision'' many-body description of RuO$_2$ and allows remaining discrepancies to be identified as meaningful tests of the theory. In particular, the calculated electronic thermal resistivity significantly undershoots the experimentally inferred low-temperature thermal resistivity, raising an important puzzle concerning the relative relaxation of charge and heat currents in the Fermi liquid regime. We explore low-temperature electron-phonon scattering as a possible mechanism for resolving this discrepancy, while a fully quantitative description remains an open problem. More broadly, our results demonstrate the power of combining precision DFT+DMFT calculations with complementary experimental probes to build and critically test quantitative descriptions of correlated quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 用DFT+DMFT对RuO₂进行精确多体计算，定量重现光谱与输运性质，并发现电子热阻与实验不符的谜题。
AI.motivation: RuO₂是多轨道费米液体，近期积累了大量互补实验数据，是检验定量多体电子结构理论的严格测试平台。
AI.method: 采用现实的动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT）计算RuO₂顺磁态的光谱与输运性质，并探讨低温电子-声子散射机制。
AI.result: 与实验的光电导率、电阻率和热电势达到（半）定量一致；但计算的电子热阻明显低于实验推断的低温热阻。
AI.conclusion: RuO₂是中等关联费米液体；电荷流与热流弛豫差异构成关键谜题，完全定量描述仍是开放问题，展示精确DFT+DMFT结合互补实验的威力。

title: Density Functional Theory for 2D Transition-Metal Dichalcogenides with Extended Hubbard Parameters
summary: Accurate modelling of the band-edge electronic structure of transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), such as MoS$_2$, is essential for understanding their optical, electronic and spintronic properties and enabling future applications. Here, we supplement the standard PBE exchange-correlation functional with on-metal ($U$) and metal--chalcogen ($V$) Hubbard corrections, which can control the orbital composition of band-edge states and consequently improve the quantitative accuracy of various properties. For MoS$_2$, MoSe$_2$, WS$_2$, and WSe$_2$, we optimise the $U$ and $V$ parameters by comparison with experimentally measured spin--orbit splittings at the conduction and valence band edges, and show that these optimal choices also improve agreement of the computed band gap, and ferroelectric potential drop in rhombohedral bilayers, with experimentally measured values. This provides a highly efficient, scalable framework for quantitatively accurate, high-throughput calculations of monolayer and multilayer TMDs, suitable for implementation in 2D-materials databases, as well as large-scale electronic and spintronic device modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入过渡金属(U)和金属-硫族元素(V)的Hubbard校正，优化MoS₂等TMDs的能带边缘电子结构，实现高效且定量准确的高通量计算。
AI.motivation: 准确建模TMDs（如MoS₂）的能带边缘电子结构对理解其光学、电子和自旋电子性质及未来应用至关重要，但标准PBE泛函在定量精度上存在不足。
AI.method: 在标准PBE交换关联泛函基础上，分别对过渡金属位点(U)和金属-硫族键(V)添加Hubbard校正，通过调控能带边缘态的轨道组成，并以实验测量的导带和价带边缘自旋轨道分裂值为基准，优化MoS₂、MoSe₂、WS₂、WSe₂的U和V参数。
AI.result: 优化后的U、V参数不仅与实验自旋轨道分裂吻合，还改善了带隙及菱形双层结构中铁电电势降的计算值，使其与实验测量一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架高效、可扩展且定量准确，适用于单层及多层TMDs的高通量计算，可应用于二维材料数据库及大规模电子和自旋电子器件建模。

title: Anisotropic mesoscale magnetic scattering across the spin-reorientation transition in TbMn6Sn6
summary: TbMn6Sn6 is a centrosymmetric ferrimagnetic kagome metal that combines topological electronic states with strong magnetic anisotropy and a near-room-temperature spin-reorientation transition (SRT). Real-space imaging studies of thin specimens have revealed helical stripes, biskyrmion-like textures, and skyrmion-bubble-like structures in the spin-reorientation regime. Whether such local textures develop into a bulk long-range-ordered skyrmion lattice remains unresolved. Here we present small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) results probing the mesoscale magnetism of a bulk TbMn6Sn6 single crystal. We observe no sixfold SANS Bragg pattern indicative of a long-range-ordered skyrmion lattice under the explored conditions. Instead, the dominant magnetic response is an anisotropic twofold low-Q scattering component whose intensity distribution and field dependence evolve markedly across the spin-reorientation regime. In zero field, a broad and horizontally elongated low-Q signal develops above TSR and weakens as the system approaches the paramagnetic state. At 345 K with H || b, the signal is diffuse and is suppressed rapidly below about 700 Oe. By contrast, at 310 K with H || c, close to TSR, the response is more concentrated and line-shaped and persists to higher fields. The contrasts between these scans likely reflect the combined effects of rapidly evolving magnetic anisotropy near TSR and the field geometry. Our results therefore establish a bulk anisotropic mesoscale magnetic response across the spin-reorientation regime, consistent with stripe- or domain-related textures reported by real-space imaging, while not uniquely identifying their real-space morphology.

AI.tldr: 本文用SANS研究块体TbMn6Sn6的介观磁性，未发现长程有序skyrmion晶格，而是观测到二重各向异性低-Q散射，随自旋重取向显著变化。
AI.motivation: TbMn6Sn6是中心对称铁磁kagome金属，兼具拓扑电子态、强磁各向异性和近室温自旋重取向转变；实空间成像在薄样品中观察到螺旋条纹、双skyrmion类和skyrmion泡泡状结构，但这些局域织构能否在块体中形成长程有序skyrmion晶格尚不明确。
AI.method: 对块体TbMn6Sn6单晶进行小角中子散射（SANS），探测其介观磁性；在零场及345 K（H||b）、310 K（H||c）等条件下测量低-Q散射的强度分布与场依赖。
AI.result: 在探索条件下未观察到指示长程有序skyrmion晶格的六重SANS布拉格图样；主导响应为各向异性二重低-Q散射。零场下，TSR以上出现宽且水平拉长的低-Q信号，接近顺磁态时减弱。345 K、H||b时信号弥散，约700 Oe以下迅速被抑制；310 K、H||c（接近TSR）时响应更集中、呈线状，并持续到更高场。差异可能源于TSR附近快速演化的磁各向异性与场几何的共同作用。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了TbMn6Sn6在自旋重取向区间存在块体各向异性介观磁响应，与实空间成像报道的条纹或畴相关织构一致，但不能唯一确定其真实空间形貌。

title: Terahertz nanoscopy of quantum-geometric photovoltaics in bilayer graphene
summary: The bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE) provides a direct link between quantum geometry and nonlinear light-matter interactions, yet conventional far-field measurements cannot disentangle BPVE from contact- and interface-induced photothermoelectric signals. Here we develop cryogenic, polarization-sensitive terahertz microscopy with deep-subwavelength resolution and apply it to dual-gated AB bilayer graphene. Near resonance between the band gap and terahertz photon energy, we observe enhanced optical conductivity and spatially resolved BPVE. Polarization-dependent measurements reveal a characteristic twofold angular symmetry and a distinct shift-vector direction, both governed by crystalline symmetries and quantum geometry. The evolution of BPVE with carrier density and temperature provides a sensitive probe of the fine electronic structure of bilayer graphene, revealing signatures of trigonal warping and electron-hole asymmetry. Agreement with theory demonstrates that the terahertz nanoscopy of BPVE established here offers an optical lens into the interplay between band and quantum geometry in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了低温、偏振敏感的深亚波长太赫兹显微镜，用于分离和探测AB双层石墨烯中的体光伏效应（BPVE），揭示其与量子几何和能带结构的关联。
AI.motivation: 传统远场测量无法将BPVE与接触及界面诱导的光热电信号区分开来，因此需要一种能够空间分辨并排除干扰的测量手段来研究BPVE。
AI.method: 采用低温、偏振敏感的太赫兹显微镜（深亚波长分辨率），应用于双栅AB双层石墨烯；在带隙与太赫兹光子能量共振附近测量光导率和空间分辨的BPVE，并进行偏振依赖测量。
AI.result: 在带隙与太赫兹光子能量共振附近观察到增强的光导率和空间分辨的BPVE；偏振测量显示特征性的二重角对称性和明显的漂移矢量方向，受晶体对称性和量子几何支配；BPVE随载流子密度和温度的演化揭示了三角翘曲和电子-空穴不对称等精细电子结构特征，并与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立的BPVE太赫兹纳米显微技术可作为光学视角，探究量子材料中能带与量子几何的相互作用。

title: Computing at the Edge Enabled by Indoor Photovoltaics and Ferroelectrics
comment: 66 pages main text, 50 pages SI. 3 figures, 3 boxes in the main text
summary: The exponential, pervasive rise of artificial intelligence (AI), hosted in large data centres, will test the limits of the underpinning infrastructure, including electricity and water supplies, which are becoming increasingly precious resources. Rather than performing all AI computations in centralized servers, for many functionalities, these can be performed locally across a network of billions of small, autonomous nodes, saving substantial energy costs associated with communication. This alternative paradigm is known as edge computing, or distributed intelligence (DI), but has been held back by the lack of availability of reliable local energy supplies matching the energy requirements of the computational infrastructure. Opportunities to address this challenge are emerging with rapid advances in high-performance indoor photovoltaics (IPVs) for local energy harvesting, as well as reductions in computational cost through neuromorphic or in-memory computing devices. In this perspective, we discuss the requirements of IPVs for DI, the extent to which emerging materials fulfil these requirements, and how current gaps could be addressed. We make the case that (anti)ferroelectric materials can surpass bottlenecks for both electrostatic energy storage and low-power in-memory neuromorphic computing. The core theme of this perspective is that co-creation between energy harvesting, storage and computing is essential for making DI a reliable and more sustainable alternative to centralized AI.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇perspective，主张通过室内光伏（IPV）、静电储能与神经形态/存内计算器件的协同设计（co-creation），为边缘计算/分布式智能（DI）提供可靠、可持续的本地能源，从而挑战集中式AI的高能耗模式。
AI.motivation: AI大规模集中于数据中心，将逼近电力与水资源等基础设施极限；将计算下沉到数十亿个小节点的边缘计算/分布式智能可节省通信能耗，但长期受限于缺乏与计算负载匹配的可靠本地能源。
AI.method: 以perspective形式，分析DI对室内光伏（IPV）的需求、新兴材料满足程度及差距，并论证(反)铁电材料可同时突破静电储能与低功耗存内神经形态计算的瓶颈。
AI.result: 指出高性能室内光伏的快速进展、神经形态/存内计算降低计算成本的趋势为解决DI能源问题带来机遇；(反)铁电材料被认为能超越能量存储与低功耗计算两方面的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 能量收集、存储与计算的协同创造（co-creation）是使DI成为集中式AI更可靠且更可持续替代方案的关键；未来应弥合材料与系统层面的现有差距。

title: Chirality-induced spin selectivity as a nonequilibrium effect: a unified test of competing mechanisms
summary: For two decades, the origin of Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity (CISS), the spin polarization of electrons by nonmagnetic chiral systems without magnetic fields, has remained unsettled. Here, we establish a single exact rule defining the fundamental conditions for the effect: in nonmagnetic, time-reversal-invariant conductors, all measurable CISS signals are time-reversal odd and vanish near equilibrium, proving that structural chirality alone is insufficient. By evaluating leading theoretical mechanisms across four levels of nonequilibrium transport, from coherent classical driving to fully non-Markovian quantum baths, we verify this selection rule to machine precision. We show that coherent chiral vibrations generate substantial collinear polarization (up to 10 percent across 0.5-6 THz) that reverses with handedness, whereas incoherent vibrations yield under 1 percent, and non-Markovian bath memory further suppresses the signal. The chiral geometry first makes the electronic motion chiral by accumulating orbital angular momentum; spin-orbit coupling (SOC) then converts that into spin. CISS therefore acts as both a spin polarizer and a spin filter, the latter an order of magnitude weaker. The polarization grows with molecular length and then saturates, matching trends reported for DNA and peptides. Reversing the drive converts decaying spin into a handedness-locked charge-current pulse (inverse-CISS). We find that once the system is driven, the polarization magnitude scales with an effective spin-orbit coupling: making heavy atoms and curved light-atom backbones indistinguishable at equivalent effective SOC. This enables us to chart how geometry, driving field, and length separate those routes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CISS效应存在的单一精确判据：在非磁性、时间反演不变导体中，所有可测CISS信号都是时间反演奇性的，在平衡态附近消失，故仅结构手性不足；并据此系统评估了四类非平衡输运机制。
AI.motivation: 手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应的起源二十年来悬而未决，即非磁性手性系统在无磁场下如何实现电子自旋极化缺乏统一的理论规则。
AI.method: 建立单一精确判据（时间反演奇性、平衡态消失的选择定则），并在从相干经典驱动到完全非马尔可夫量子浴的四个非平衡输运层次上评估主要理论机制，验证选择定则。
AI.result: 相干手性振动产生显著共线极化（0.5-6 THz下最高约10%）并随手性反转；非相干振动低于1%，非马尔可夫浴记忆进一步抑制信号。手性几何先积累轨道角动量使电子运动手性化，SOC再将其转为自旋。极化随分子长度增长后饱和，与DNA和肽趋势一致。反向驱动可将衰减自旋转为手性锁定的电流脉冲（逆CISS）。驱动后极化幅度随有效SOC标度，重原子与弯曲轻原子骨架在等效有效SOC下不可区分。
AI.conclusion: CISS既作自旋极化器又作自旋过滤器（后者弱一个量级）；通过几何、驱动场和长度可区分不同路径。研究为CISS提供了统一判据并阐明其机理。

title: Sliding and stacking thin homo-monolayers from energy landscapes and combinatorics
comment: Accepted by npg Quantum Materials on 10/3/2026
summary: Structure leads to function: Knowing all possible ways to stack and slide identical monolayers enables the design of functionalities such as nonlinear optical responses and ferroelectricity in layered materials. Besides, mounting experimental evidence points to differing stacking configurations in few-monolayer and bulk samples. To exemplify the core concepts for stacking arbitrary monolayers, ground-state and metastable non-moiré SnSe stacks were first identified using density functional theory and employed to validate a ``divide and conquer'' combinatoral approach for determining the most probable stacking configurations in materials with an arbitrary number of identical monolayers. A small number of point groups accounts for all possible stacks, which explains experimental second-harmonic optical responses. Finite-temperature effects are also studied despite the granularity of available data. This comprehensive framework readily generalizes to provide a predictive description of arbitrary metastable few-homomonolayer stacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分而治之"组合方法，确定任意数量相同单层的堆叠构型，并用SnSe验证，解释二次谐波响应。
AI.motivation: 结构与功能相关，已知所有可能的堆叠与滑动方式有助于设计非线性光学响应、铁电性等功能；且实验证据表明少层与体材料堆叠构型存在差异，需系统框架描述任意单层的堆叠。
AI.method: 用密度泛函理论识别SnSe的基态与亚稳非莫尔堆叠，验证"分而治之"组合方法以确定任意数量相同单层材料中最可能的堆叠构型；并研究有限温度效应。
AI.result: 少量点群即可解释所有可能堆叠，并解释实验观测的二次谐波光学响应。
AI.conclusion: 该综合框架可推广用于预测描述任意亚稳少层同质单层堆叠。

title: Gate-tunable large second-order and third-order nonlinear Hall effect in topological insulator BiSbTeSe2
summary: The nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE) holds significant promise for next-generation electronic device applications, and it is essential to explore and engineer a strong and highly tunable NLHE. In this work, we report large second-order and third-order NLHEs in dual-gated BiSbTeSe2 devices. Both the second-order and third-order NLHE are highly gate-tunable. The second-order NLHE exhibits a higher generation efficiency than those reported in previous topological insulator systems, and it can be stably observed up to room temperature. Meanwhile, the generation efficiency of the third-order NLHE is comparable to previously reported values. The scaling analysis indicates that the second-order NLHE is consistent with contributions from skew scattering and a term compatible with either the Berry curvature dipole or side jump, whereas the third-order NLHE is consistent with contributions from the Berry connection polarizability tensor and higher-order skew scattering. Our work establishes a promising experimental platform for the development of NLHE-based devices.

AI.tldr: 本文在双栅BiSbTeSe2器件中报道了强且高度可调的大二阶和三阶非线性霍尔效应，并揭示了各自的散射机制。
AI.motivation: 非线性霍尔效应（NLHE）在下一代电子器件中前景广阔，因此需要探索并调控强且高度可调的NLHE。
AI.method: 采用双栅控BiSbTeSe2器件，测量其二阶和三阶NLHE，并通过标度分析研究其物理机制。
AI.result: 二阶和三阶NLHE均高度可栅控；二阶NLHE生成效率高于以往拓扑绝缘体体系，可稳定观测至室温；三阶NLHE效率与已有报道相当。标度分析表明二阶NLHE源自斜散射及与贝里曲率偶极或边跳相符的贡献，三阶NLHE源自贝里联络极化率张量和高阶斜散射。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为基于NLHE的器件开发建立了有前景的实验平台。

title: A Scale-Separated Full-Field Monopole Method for Precipitation Modelling
summary: A scale-separated monopole method is developed for full-field prediction of precipitation under conditions where particle-scale diffusion fields coexist with solute variations over much larger distances. Precipitates are represented by monopole Green's-function solutions, providing a particle-based description of interacting particle growth and dissolution. The direct quasistatic formulation is validated against transient finite-difference calculations and a conventional Kampmann--Wagner numerical model, but becomes inappropriate when spatially heterogeneous particle populations generate slowly relaxing long-wavelength concentration fields. An Ewald decomposition is therefore used to separate the diffusion field by spatial scale. Screened particle-scale fields are treated quasistatically, while the complementary long-range field evolves by transient diffusion. The resulting hybrid formulation retains explicit particle-level precipitation kinetics while allowing mesoscale solute redistribution to evolve on its physical timescale. Application to Al--Sc demonstrates that a transient depletion field generated by localized precipitation can suppress subsequent nucleation and produce persistent spatial variations in precipitate number density and volume fraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出尺度分离的单极子方法，用于粒子尺度扩散场与远距离溶质变化共存条件下的沉淀全場预测，通过Ewald分解实现混合求解。
AI.motivation: 当粒子尺度扩散场与大尺度溶质分布变化共存时，直接准静态表述不再适用，因为空间非均匀粒子群会产生缓慢弛豫的长波浓度场。
AI.method: 用单极子格林函数表示沉淀物，建立粒子级交互生长与溶解描述；采用Ewald分解按空间尺度分离扩散场，屏蔽的粒子尺度场准静态处理，长程场用瞬态扩散演化。
AI.result: 直接准静态表述经瞬态有限差与Kampmann-Wagner数值模型验证；Al-Sc应用显示局部沉淀产生的瞬态贫化场可抑制后续形核，并造成持久空间不均匀的沉淀数密度与体积分数。
AI.conclusion: 该混合表述保留了显式粒子级沉淀动力学，同时允许中尺度溶质再分布在物理时间尺度上演化，适用于尺度分离的沉淀模拟。

title: Current selects the helicity of a chiral phonon
summary: The emergence of spin-polarized electrons from nonmagnetic chiral molecules and crystals is called Chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS). A chiral phonon of definite wavevector $q$ can strongly enhance it, but near equilibrium the two helicities $+q$ and $-q$ are equally populated: they are time-reversal partners and their contributions cancel. We show that in a biased chiral conductor the current causes the phonon of one helicity to damp less than the other. The damping asymmetry is odd in the current, odd under $q\rightarrow-q$, invariant under a mirror that reverses the structural handedness, and equal, mode for mode, to the current-induced nonconservative Berry force on the phonon coordinate. Closing the phonon kinetics with a rate equation turns the asymmetry into a net lattice helicity: at any finite bias one helicity is preferentially populated, with no threshold, growing linearly with the current as $V\rightarrow0$; above a threshold that helicity becomes a self-sustained coherent travelling wave. We demonstrate this effect in elemental tellurium, treated as an open quantum system (electronic Hamiltonian, phonon bath, and electron-phonon coupling) within a quasi-ab initio framework. The electronic Hamiltonian is supplied by a vertex-corrected quasiparticle self-consistent $GW$ (QSGW) potential with spin-orbit coupling; nuclear displacements are modeled with a machine-learned interatomic potential, which yields chiral phonon modes at finite $\pm q_z$ on the $Γ$-A line. The perturbation to the electronic Hamiltonian from a nuclear displacement is approximated by a frozen-phonon deformation potential. No optical pump is needed: a bias alone drives the current and selects the phonon helicity; reversing the current reverses the selection.

AI.tldr: 在偏置的手性导体中，电流使某一手性声子衰减较小，从而在无阈值下选择性占据一种晶格手性，并可在阈值以上形成自持相干行波；以元素碲为例在准从头算框架下验证。
AI.motivation: CISS（手性诱导自旋选择性）可由特定波矢手性声子显著增强，但平衡时+q与-q等量占据且互为时间反演伙伴，贡献相消；作者试图寻找一种无需光泵浦、仅靠电流即可打破这种平衡并选择声子手性的机制。
AI.method: 提出在偏置手性导体中电流导致一种手性声子衰减小于另一种，其衰减不对称性对电流为奇、对q→-q为奇、在反转结构手性的镜像下不变，并逐模等于电流诱导的非保守Berry力；用速率方程闭合声子动力学，得到净晶格手性。以元素碲为对象，构建开量子系统（电子哈密顿量、声子浴、电子-声子耦合）的准从头算框架：电子哈密顿量用带自旋轨道耦合的顶点修正QSGW势，核位移用机器学习原子间势（在Γ-A线上给出有限±q_z手性声子模），电子哈密顿量的微扰用冻结声子形变势近似。
AI.result: 在任何有限偏置下一种手性被优先占据，无阈值，且V→0时随电流线性增长；在阈值以上该手性成为自持相干行波。电流反向则选择的手性反转。无需光学泵浦，仅靠偏置即可驱动电流并选择声子手性。
AI.conclusion: 电流诱导的声子衰减不对称性可作为选择晶格手性的机制，将CISS与手性声子动力学联系起来，并在元素碲中通过准从头算开量子系统计算得到演示。

title: Deconvoluting Mechanisms of Radiation-Induced Grain Boundary Segregation in Dilute Ni-X (X = Fe, Cr, Mn) Alloys via Ion Irradiation and Phase-field Modeling
summary: Radiation-induced composition redistribution at grain boundaries (GBs) in Ni-based structural alloys poses a critical challenge for the long-term deployment of advanced nuclear reactors. The mechanisms governing solute-specific segregation remain poorly understood because defect-mediated transport, thermodynamic driving forces, and competing microstructural sinks can all contribute under irradiation. We perform systematic Ni2+ ion irradiations on dilute Ni-Fe, Ni-Cr, and Ni-Mn binary alloys at 500, 800, and 1000 K to 2 dpa and characterize GB chemistry using STEM-EDS. The segregation behavior is interpreted using rate-theory phase-field modeling informed by atomistic transport data. We find that Fe depletes at GBs across all temperatures via preferential vacancy-solute exchange (inverse Kirkendall effect). Cr segregation reflects a temperature-dependent competition between self-interstitial atom (SIA)-mediated transport toward GBs and vacancy-mediated transport away from GBs, yielding near-zero net segregation at 500 K and depletion at higher temperatures. In contrast, Mn exhibits distinct behavior dominated by thermodynamic segregation that drives local enrichment at the GB. We leverage depth-dependent characterization along the same GB, spanning irradiated and unirradiated regions, to separate radiation-induced and thermodynamic contributions and validate the unirradiated region as an internal thermodynamic reference. Void formation at 800 K and irradiation-induced GB migration at 800 and 1000 K further add mechanistic complexity by suppressing and redistributing the solute. Our combined experimental and computational assessments show that interpreting GB chemistry evolution under irradiation requires concurrent treatment of non-equilibrium kinetic transport, thermodynamic driving forces, bulk sink effects, and GB migration.

AI.tldr: 通过Ni离子辐照Ni-Fe/Cr/Mn二元合金，结合STEM-EDS表征与相场模型，揭示晶界偏析的温度依赖机制：Fe耗尽、Cr随温度转变、Mn热力学富集。
AI.motivation: 辐照诱导晶界成分再分布在Ni基合金中对先进核反应堆长期服役构成关键挑战，但溶质特异性偏析机制不清，因缺陷介导输运、热力学驱动力与竞争性微结构汇均可能起作用。
AI.method: 在500、800、1000 K对稀Ni-Fe、Ni-Cr、Ni-Mn二元合金进行Ni2+离子辐照至2 dpa；用STEM-EDS表征晶界化学；采用基于原子尺度输运数据的速率理论相场建模解释偏析行为；并沿同一晶界做深度依赖表征，区分辐照与热力学贡献。
AI.result: Fe在所有温度下因优先空位-溶质交换（逆Kirkendall效应）在晶界耗尽；Cr偏析体现SIA向晶界输运与空位离开晶界输运的温度依赖竞争，500 K净偏析近零，更高温度下耗尽；Mn表现为由热力学偏析主导、驱动晶界局部富集。800 K空洞形成及800/1000 K辐照诱导晶界迁移进一步抑制和再分布溶质。
AI.conclusion: 解释辐照下晶界化学演化需同时考虑非平衡动力学输运、热力学驱动力、体汇效应与晶界迁移；未辐照区可作为内部热力学参考。

title: Mirror-Constrained Optical Hall Rectification in Asymmetric Gold Gratings:\\ Edelstein Conversion and a Phase-Seeded Kerr Four-Wave Mixing Instability
summary: Transverse optical rectification has been reported in a one-dimensional asymmetric Au grating even though an ideal profile $h(x)$ retains the $xz$ mirror $\Me:y\to-y$. Because $J_y$ is odd under $\Me$, whereas the $p$-polarized bilinears $|E_x|^2$, $|E_z|^2$, and $\mathrm{Re}(E_xE_z^*)$ are even, the transverse dc current requires a distinct mirror-odd factor $\Lamy$. We formulate a symmetry-complete effective model combining the origin-independent cell invariant $\Astr=\mathrm{Im}(h_1^2h_2^*)$, Drude--Edelstein spin polarization, and spin--orbit conversion. We then propose a dynamical realization of $\Lamy$ for a finite-width device. A driven pump-like plasmonic mode at $k_y\simeq0$ generates a mirror pair of transverse surface-plasmon-polariton quasinormal modes $(K_x,\pm q_y)$ through the same third-order susceptibility that produces self- and cross-Kerr shifts. Four-wave mixing creates the pair and locks its phase sum but, by itself, cannot change the pair-population difference. Weak coherent backscattering makes the relative drive phase observable; a small phase difference from incident $k_y$, spot displacement, edges, or disorder then unfolds a Kerr directional instability and deterministically selects its sign. The resulting population imbalance supplies the dynamical mirror-odd factor $\Ldyn=λ_ηη$ in the structure-dependent $\Astr\Lamy\langle j_xs_y\rangle_t$ side-jump-like channel, which vanishes for the centered symmetric grating because $\Astr=0$. We give the complete three-mode equations, the pump-only and saturated-state Bogoliubov problems, the imperfect-pitchfork reduction, and a validated normalized numerical realization. The normalized equations exhibit a robust supercritical pitchfork with an approximately one-half critical exponent and phase-reversed branch selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维非对称Au光栅中的横向光学整流：理想轮廓h(x)保持xz镜面对称，但实验中却观测到横向直流电流。作者构建含镜面奇因子的对称完备有效模型，并提出通过等离激元四波混频与Kerr方向不稳定性动态产生该镜面奇因子的机制。
AI.motivation: 理想Au光栅轮廓h(x)在Me:y→-y下保持不变，而横向电流Jy在Me下为奇，p偏振双线性项|Ex|²、|Ez|²、Re(ExEz*)却为偶，因此横向直流电流必然需要额外的镜面奇因子Lamy，但其来源与产生机制此前缺乏自洽解释。
AI.method: 作者建立对称完备的有效模型，结合原点无关的胞不变量Astr=Im(h1²h2*)、Drude-Edelstein自旋极化与自旋-轨道转换；进而提出有限宽度器件的动力学实现：k_y≈0的泵浦等离激元模通过三阶非线性产生镜面对(Kx,±qy)的SPP准简正模，四波混频锁定相位和，弱相干背散射使相对相位可观测，来自入射ky、光斑位移、边缘或无序的微小相位差触发Kerr方向不稳定性，确定性选择符号，形成布居失衡从而提供Ldyn=ληη。
AI.result: 给出完整的三模方程、仅泵浦与饱和态的Bogoliubov问题、非完美分岔约化及经验证的归一化数值实现。归一化方程展现鲁棒的超临界叉形分岔，临界指数约为1/2，并伴有相位反转的分支选择。
AI.conclusion: 横向光学整流所需的镜面奇因子可由动力学布居失衡产生的Ldyn提供，与结构相关的Astr共同进入AstrLamy⟨jx sy⟩t类跳跃通道；对中心对称光栅因Astr=0而消失，实现了对实验横向直流电流的对称完备解释。

title: Stability and current-driven dynamics of mixed-topology bimeron clusters
summary: In this work, we study bimerons (in-plane skyrmions) and their clusters composed of states with mixed topological indices. These clusters provide flexibility in controlling the skyrmion Hall angle, which depends on the cluster's total topological charge. First, using the simplest such cluster, a bimeron-antibimeron pair, we examine its stability with the geodesic nudged elastic band method and identify three mechanisms -- bimeron separation, interchange, and annihilation -- with comparable energy barriers that determine the pair's overall stability. This provides an upper bound for the stability of more sophisticated clusters of bimerons and antibimerons. Then, we numerically study the clusters' dynamics for currents applied in-plane and perpendicular to the plane, corresponding to the Zhang-Li and Slonczewski mechanisms. Finally, we analyze the dynamics of a wide variety of bimeron clusters within the Thiele approach and show that their velocities always lie on a specific ellipse whose parameters are fully governed by the model Hamiltonian.

AI.tldr: 研究了平面内斯格明子（bimeron）及其混合拓扑荷团簇的稳定性与动力学，发现其速度落在由哈密顿量决定的特定椭圆上。
AI.motivation: 探索由混合拓扑指标态组成的bimeron团簇，以灵活调控依赖总拓扑荷的斯格明子霍尔角。
AI.method: 用测地线微动弹性带（GNEB）方法分析bimeron-antibimeron对的稳定性；数值模拟面内与垂直电流（Zhang-Li与Slonczewski机制）下的动力学；用Thiele方法分析多种团簇动力学。
AI.result: 识别出分离、互换、湮灭三种能量势垒相当机制，给出稳定性上界；团簇速度始终落在由模型哈密顿量完全决定的特定椭圆上。
AI.conclusion: bimeron团簇提供了调控斯格明子霍尔角的灵活性，其动力学受Thiele框架下椭圆规律支配。

title: Ferromagnetic Bloch Line as a Bead on a String
summary: We present a simple model of a Bloch line in a thin-film ferromagnet with strong easy-axis and intermediate in-plane anisotropies. The meron is represented as a charged, massless particle that slides along the linear domain wall in a background magnetic field- a gyroscopic bead on a string. Its gyroscopic behavior dynamically isolates the wall segments on either side of the meron, motivating the model for a Bloch line as two strings joined at a moving boundary. The meron clamps the wall at this junction, completely reflecting low-amplitude spin waves that propagate along it. Out-of-plane and in-plane magnetic fields and spin-transfer torques then act in two ways: by exerting a force on the Bloch line itself, or by driving the wall as a whole. Predictions of this model are in agreement with numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出薄膜铁磁体中Bloch线的简化模型，将meron视为沿畴壁滑动的带电荷无质量粒子（"弦上陀螺珠"），并解释其对自旋波的反射及外场和自旋转移矩的响应，与数值模拟一致。
AI.motivation: 在具有强易轴和中等面内各向异性的薄膜铁磁体中，Bloch线的动力学行为复杂，需要一个简洁的物理模型来理解meron沿畴壁的运动及其与自旋波、外场和自旋转移矩的相互作用。
AI.method: 将meron建模为带电荷的无质量粒子，在背景磁场中沿线性畴壁滑动（陀螺珠在弦上）；利用其陀螺行为动态隔离两侧畴壁段，将Bloch线建模为在移动边界处连接的两条弦；分析面外/面内磁场和自旋转移矩通过两种方式作用（直接对Bloch线施力或整体驱动畴壁）。
AI.result: meron在连接处钳制畴壁，完全反射沿其传播的低振幅自旋波；模型对磁场和自旋转移矩响应的预测与数值模拟结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 该简化模型成功捕捉了Bloch线的关键动力学特征，为理解和预测薄膜铁磁体中Bloch线的行为提供了直观且有效的理论框架。

title: Geometrical Confinement of Magnetic Domains and Domain Walls on Two-Dimensional Cylindrical-Shaped Ferromagnetic Surfaces
summary: The rolling of two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) magnetic monolayers into cylindrical architectures provides an ideal platform for confining magnetic domain walls (DWs) without edge-pinning effects. Here, we present a combined analytical and numerical investigation of DW confinement and interaction in ferromagnetic (FM) nanotubes. Using an analytical Heisenberg model on a 2D rectangular lattice, we show that transversal curvature introduces an azimuthal exchange energy penalty that intrinsically compresses the DW width. This model demonstrates excellent quantitative agreement with atomistic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) spin dynamics simulations. By extending our study to realistic CrSBr (CSB) nanotubes, we model a bound state of two interacting DWs arising from a balance between long-range dipolar attraction and short-range exchange repulsion. Micromagnetic simulations reveal a non-monotonic evolution of the inter-wall distance with the tube perimeter. These findings highlight vdW magnetic nanotubes as robust platforms for stable domain confinement in quasi-one-dimensional spintronic architectures.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过解析Heisenberg模型与LLG/微磁模拟，研究铁磁范德华纳米管中磁畴壁的限域与相互作用，揭示曲率压缩畴壁宽度及双畴壁间距随管周长的非单调演化。
AI.motivation: 二维范德华磁性单层卷成圆柱结构可避免边缘钉扎效应，是限域磁畴壁的理想平台，但曲率对畴壁限域与相互作用的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 在二维矩形晶格上建立解析Heisenberg模型，分析横向曲率引入的方位角交换能惩罚；并与原子尺度Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert自旋动力学模拟对照；进一步对真实CrSBr纳米管进行建模，采用微磁模拟研究双畴壁束缚态。
AI.result: 解析模型与原子模拟定量吻合；曲率通过方位交换能惩罚本征地压缩畴壁宽度；在CrSBr纳米管中观测到长程偶极吸引与短程交换排斥平衡形成的双畴壁束缚态，且畴壁间距随管周长呈非单调变化。
AI.conclusion: 范德华磁性纳米管可作为稳定磁畴限域的稳健平台，适用于准一维自旋电子学架构。

title: Beyond the Flat-Band Paradigm: Open Orbits as a Route to Correlated States in Dispersive Moiré Minibands
summary: The realization of fractional Chern insulators has largely relied on isolated flat bands in complex bilayer or multilayer moiré systems with ideal quantum geometry. Whether such phases can emerge in genuinely dispersive bands, and by what mechanism, remains an open question. Here, we propose a mechanism for magnetic-field-induced strong correlations in the highly dispersive bands of monolayer graphene on hexagonal boron nitride. In the low-field classical-to-quantum crossover regime of the second moiré miniband, we show that the interplay of the moiré potential and weak magnetic fields (B < 1.5 T) profoundly alters electron dynamics. Saddle-point van Hove singularities produce extended open orbits that strongly suppress carrier propagation, potentially favoring a regime in which Coulomb interactions become comparatively more important, while weak magnetic fields lift valley degeneracy and trigonal warping redistributes Berry curvature. High-resolution magnetotransport and temperature-dependent measurements reveal fractional-slope transport features and signatures of interaction-driven incompressibility. Because the Hall conductivity is not fully quantized and the longitudinal resistance remains finite, we describe these observations as incipient FCI behavior: transport signatures consistent with a developing fractional Chern insulating state, without claiming a fully developed FCI phase established by complete Hall quantization and vanishing longitudinal resistance. Our results suggest a possible fermiology-driven route toward correlated topological states in dispersive bands in the classical-to-quantum crossover, distinct from the conventional flat-band scenario.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在单层石墨烯/h-BN高色散带中，通过第二moiré微带的低场经典-量子过渡区机制，利用鞍点范霍夫奇点产生的开放轨道抑制载流子传播，实现磁场诱导的强关联，并在输运中观察到初生（incipient）分数量子-Chern绝缘行为。
AI.motivation: 以往分数量子Chern绝缘体（FCI）多依赖复杂双层或多层moiré体系中的孤立平带与理想量子几何。色散带中能否涌现此类拓扑关联相、以及其机制，尚不清楚。作者希望探索一种不依赖平带的新路径。
AI.method: 理论结合实验：在单层石墨烯/h-BN体系的第二moiré微带、低场（B<1.5 T）经典-量子过渡区，分析moiré势与弱磁场的相互作用，考察鞍点范霍夫奇点、开放轨道、谷简并解除与三角翘曲对Berry曲率重分布的影响；并进行高分辨磁输运与变温测量。
AI.result: 观察分数斜率输运特征及相互作用驱动不可压缩性的signature。但霍尔电导未完全量子化、纵向电阻仍有限，故称为“初生FCI行为”，即与正在发展的分数量子Chern绝缘态一致的输运特征，而非完全确立的FCI相。
AI.conclusion: 色散带中可通过“费米学驱动”途径，在经典-量子过渡区实现关联拓扑态，区别于传统平带机制。

title: Giant Conductance Enhancement in Graphene Nanoscrolls via Interlayer-Coupled States
summary: Graphene nanoscrolls form a unique radial superlattice whose geometry enables transport behaviors distinct from their flat counterparts. We theoretically demonstrate that rolling a graphene nanoribbon into a few-turn nanoscroll (1.0-1.2 turns) triggers a giant enhancement in longitudinal conductance by an order of magnitude (nearly twentyfold). We show that this effect stems from interlayer hopping between open boundaries, which not only transforms localized edge states into one-dimensional-like conducting channels and also induces a significant Fermi energy shift. Our results reveal an inverse scaling of conductance with turn number, establishing GNSs as a platform for geometry-driven quantum transport and offering a tunable approach to engineering nanoarchitectural electronic states.

AI.tldr: 将石墨烯纳米带卷成1.0-1.2圈的少圈纳米卷，可使纵向电导提升近二十倍，源于开口边界间的层间跃迁将边缘态转化为类一维导电通道。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯纳米卷的径向超晶格几何不同于平面石墨烯，可能带来独特输运行为，但需理论厘清其机制。
AI.method: 理论上将石墨烯纳米带卷成少圈（1.0-1.2圈）纳米卷，分析层间跃迁、边缘态与费米能位移。
AI.result: 纵向电导出现数量级（近二十倍）的巨增强；开口边界层间跃迁把局域边缘态变成类一维导电通道并引起显著费米能移动；电导随圈数呈反比缩放。
AI.conclusion: 石墨烯纳米卷可作为几何驱动量子输运的平台，为调控纳米结构电子态提供可调手段。

title: Compressed magnetic Moment Tensor Potentials via low-rank matrix and tensor factorizations
summary: We propose a parameter-reduced version of magnetic Moment Tensor Potential (mMTP) based on various matrix and tensor decompositions. The resulting compressed magnetic machine-learning potential reduces the number of parameters by a factor of approximately 1.5-3 without compromising predictive performance on the validation set. We evaluate the performance of the compressed potentials for magnetic, structural, and vibrational properties, as well as in molecular dynamics simulations of Fe-Al and CrN systems. We demonstrate that the simulation results obtained with the compressed mMTP are numerically consistent with those of the original uncompressed model and are in agreement with density functional theory calculations and experimental data.

AI.tldr: 提出基于矩阵与张量分解的参数精简版磁性矩张量势(mMTP)，参数量减少约1.5-3倍且性能无损。
AI.motivation: 磁性矩张量势(mMTP)参数量较大，需在保持预测性能的同时精简参数以提升效率。
AI.method: 基于多种矩阵和张量分解方法，构建参数精简的压缩磁性机器学习势。
AI.result: 参数量减少约1.5-3倍，验证集性能不变；在Fe-Al和CrN的磁性、结构、振动性质及分子动力学模拟中，压缩mMTP结果与原模型数值一致，且与DFT及实验数据吻合。
AI.conclusion: 压缩mMTP能有效降低参数量而不损失精度，适用于磁性材料的可靠模拟。

title: Intrinsic spin-orbit coupling in graphene stacks
summary: The effect of spin-orbit coupling (SOC) in monolayer graphene has been thoroughly studied in the past. Its impact is commonly disregarded since the electronic structure of graphene is almost unaffected. Consequently, SOC has also been ignored in other graphitic systems. In this work, we calculate the intrinsic SOC in stacks of graphene layers from a model that includes all the valence orbitals of carbon as well as the intra-atomic SOC.The leading spin-orbit term in a graphene multilayer combines a Rashba-like spin-flip process with interlayer hopping. We find that this intrinsic term modifies the phase diagram and Fermi surfaces of finite rhombohedral stacks, and it leads to a distinct density-dependence of the magnetization in weak magnetic fields. This Letter shows that, unlike in the single-layer case, SOC has important consequences in multilayer graphitic systems and it should not be neglected when studying their physical properties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多层石墨烯堆叠中的本征自旋轨道耦合(SOC)，发现其主要项将Rashba型自旋翻转与层间跃迁结合，会改变有限菱形堆叠的相图和费米面，并导致弱磁场下磁化强度呈现独特的密度依赖关系，因此SOC在多层石墨体系中不可忽略。
AI.motivation: 单层石墨烯中SOC对电子结构几乎无影响，因此以往研究普遍忽视SOC，并习惯性地将其在其它石墨体系中也一并忽略。作者希望检验这一惯性假设在多层石墨烯堆叠中是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 采用包含碳原子全部价轨道以及原子内SOC的模型，计算石墨烯多层堆叠中的本征SOC。
AI.result: 多层石墨烯中的主导自旋轨道项是Rashba型自旋翻转过程与层间跃迁的结合；该项修正了有限菱形堆叠的相图和费米面，并导致弱磁场下磁化强度出现独特的密度依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 与单层情形不同，SOC在多层石墨体系中具有重要影响，在研究其物理性质时不应被忽略。

title: State aligned graph wavelet fingerprints of electron trapping in amorphous Si$_3$N$_4$
summary: Classifying charge traps in amorphous materials requires the electronic state and the network response to be resolved together. We develop state-aligned graph-wavelet fingerprints and apply them to electron trapping in a-Si$_3$N$_4$, where intrinsic-polaronic trapping, coordination-driven trapping, and charge-driven conversion coexist within one ensemble. Across 415 pairs of relaxed neutral and negatively charged cells, alignment of the trap state before and after localisation connects electronic identity to multiscale structural fingerprints. Charge-driven conversion produces substantial reorganisation across graph scales and increases the fingerprint amplitude. The fingerprint change identifies the transformation each site undergoes, while the occupation-induced level shift tracks localisation gain and graph deformation tracks stabilisation. Charge-induced defect formation dominates the deepest spectral-trap decile: 69\% form at sites whose Si--N bond breaks on capture, although this route accounts for 44.2\% of the classified traps. The fingerprints unify electronic identity, multiscale network reorganisation and energetic stabilisation in a quantitative framework for resolving charge trapping in amorphous materials.

AI.tldr: 提出状态对齐图小波指纹方法，联合解析非晶材料中电荷陷阱的电子态与网络响应，并应用于a-Si₃N₄的电子俘获研究。
AI.motivation: 非晶材料中电荷陷阱的分类需要同时解析电子态与网络响应，但二者难以协同刻画。
AI.method: 开发状态对齐的图小波指纹，对415对弛豫中性/带负电晶胞中陷阱态在局域化前后的电子身份与多尺度结构指纹进行对齐分析。
AI.result: 电荷驱动转换引起跨图尺度的显著重组并增强指纹幅度；指纹变化可识别各位点的转变类型，占据诱导能级移动追踪局域化增益，图变形追踪稳定化；电荷诱导缺陷形成主导最深光谱陷阱十分位，其中69%源于俘获时Si–N键断裂的位点（该路径占分类陷阱44.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 指纹方法将电子身份、多尺度网络重组与能量稳定化统一于定量框架，可解析非晶材料中的电荷俘获。

title: Influence of Electrode Thickness and Electrolyte Composition on SEI Formation and Cycle Stability in Binder-Free Hard Carbon Anodes for Na-Ion Batteries
summary: Hard carbon self-supported electrodes (HC SSEs) have gained significant interest as an alternative to classical binder-based anode materials for sodium-ion batteries (SIBs), eliminating the need for binders, solvents, conductive carbon, and current collectors. In this work, we investigate the impact of HC thickness and macroporosity, as well as the presence/absence of an electrolyte additive, on the formation of the solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) and electrochemical performance. Three cellulose-based filter paper (FP) precursors with different thicknesses were used to prepare HC SSEs through a pyrolysis process at 1500 {\textdegree}C, and then these were compared with an HC SSE obtained from commercial carbon fabric. The results highlight the importance of appropriate structural, morphological, porosity, and surface chemical properties of the materials to achieve high initial Coulombic efficiency (up to 93%) and high reversible capacity (up to 328 mAh g -1 at 37.2 mA g -1 ). However, the cycle stability was greatly impacted by the electrode thickness/macroporosity and the electrolyte additive. In NaPF6 without fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) additive, the maximum number of cycles (50) was obtained for the thinnest electrode (79 $μ$m), while rapid fading (after $\approx$1-5 cycles) was observed for electrode thicknesses >185 $μ$m. By using the FEC additive, the fading is mitigated and cycling stability (100 cycles) is reached for all the electrodes, except the commercial one (5 cycles), due to its highest thickness (1042 $μ$m). The improvement in stability could be explained by the buildup of a thin homogeneous inorganic-rich SEI containing more NaF in the presence of FEC, which is more stable, protective, and electronically conductive.

AI.tldr: 研究硬碳自支撑电极的厚度、大孔率及FEC添加剂对SEI和电化学性能的影响，发现FEC可形成薄而均匀的无机富NaF SEI，显著提升循环稳定性。
AI.motivation: 硬碳自支撑电极可免除粘结剂、溶剂、导电碳和集流体，是钠离子电池的理想负极，但其厚度、孔隙结构与电解液添加剂如何影响SEI形成与性能尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以三种不同厚度的纤维素滤纸为前驱体，经1500℃热解制备硬碳自支撑电极，并与商用碳布对比；考察厚度、大孔率及FEC添加剂对SEI和电化学性能的影响。
AI.result: 获得高达93%的首次库仑效率和328 mAh/g（37.2 mA/g）的可逆容量。无FEC时，仅最薄电极（79 μm）循环50次，厚度>185 μm的电极约1-5次后快速衰减；加FEC后多数电极达100次循环（商用因1042 μm厚度仅5次）。
AI.conclusion: FEC添加促进形成薄、均匀、无机富NaF的SEI，更稳定、保护性更好且电子导电，从而缓解衰减；电极厚度和大孔率是影响循环稳定性的关键因素。

title: An \textit{ab initio} based compact analytical formula for inelastic x-ray scattering from spatially localized excitons
summary: In this contribution we provide a compact model for the description of inelastic x-ray scattering of spatially localized excitons. We combine our analytical theory with first principles calculations and apply it to the material lithium fluoride (LiF). A comparison of two different approaches for the underlying single-particle wave functions to calculate the spectrum yield a qualitatively good agreement with experimental data but also shows that a detailed description of the wave functions is essential to obtain qualitative results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个描述空间局域激子非弹性X射线散射的紧凑模型，结合解析理论与第一性原理计算，并应用于氟化锂(LiF)。
AI.motivation: 需要一个能够描述空间局域激子非弹性X射线散射的紧凑理论模型，并与实际材料实验进行对比验证。
AI.method: 将解析理论与第一性原理计算相结合，采用两种不同的单粒子波函数方法计算散射谱，并以LiF为对象应用该模型。
AI.result: 两种波函数方法得到的谱与实验数据在定性上吻合良好，但结果表明波函数的细致描述对获得定性结果是必需的。
AI.conclusion: 该紧凑模型可用于描述局域激子的非弹性X射线散射，且准确的单粒子波函数描述对结果的可靠性至关重要。

title: The phonomagnet: Spontaneous order of phonon angular momentum
summary: Magnetism is a fundamental property of matter, typically arising from collective ordering of electronic spin and orbital angular momentum. Other quasiparticles interact with magnetism. However, they have not been considered its primary source. Here we show that phonons can generate a distinct form of magnetism through spontaneous ordering of their angular momentum. This phonomagnetism emerges from spin-phonon angular-momentum coupling, producing an effective exchange interaction between local ionic angular momenta. We show that the interaction strength depends on spin susceptibility, with a phonomagnetic phase predicted near a ferromagnetic critical point. Our theory also reveals phononic analogues of established spin models, including phonon Heisenberg, phonon $Γ$-model, and phonon Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions. Combining first-principles phonon calculations with recent data from Raman spectroscopy, we identify VI$_3$ as a candidate phonomagnet, providing a microscopic framework for interpreting the weak magnetic anomaly reported above its bulk ferromagnetic transition. These findings open avenues for new platforms for information storage and manipulation on picosecond timescales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出声子可通过其角动量自发有序产生一种新型磁性——"声子磁性"(phonomagnetism)，并预测其在铁磁临界点附近出现，以VI$_3$为候选材料。
AI.motivation: 磁性通常源于电子自旋和轨道角动量的集体有序，其他准粒子虽与磁性相互作用，但未被视作磁性的主要来源。作者希望探索声子能否成为磁性的独立起源。
AI.method: 基于自旋-声子角动量耦合建立理论，推导局域离子角动量间的有效交换相互作用，并构建声子版本的Heisenberg模型、Γ模型及Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用；结合第一性原理声子计算与Raman光谱数据进行验证。
AI.result: 发现声子磁性相互作用的强度依赖于自旋磁化率，在铁磁临界点附近可形成声子磁相；识别VI$_3$为候选声子磁体，可解释其体铁磁转变温度之上的弱磁异常。
AI.conclusion: 声子磁性为理解磁性提供了微观框架，并可为皮秒时间尺度上的信息存储与操控开辟新平台。

title: Phenomenology of reactive and dissipative nutation in antiferromagnets
summary: We formulate equations of motion for uniform magnetization dynamics in multisublattice magnets, with emphasis on a recently proposed inertial damping torque. We include intra- and intersublattice contributions to Gilbert damping, reactive inertia, and inertial damping. For a two-sublattice uniaxial antiferromagnet in an easy-axis static magnetic field, we derive the dynamical magnetic susceptibilities and approximate eigenfrequencies across all field-dependent equilibrium phases. In particular, we show how inertial damping affects the relaxation of the nutational modes and propose an experimental protocol to determine the dynamical coefficients.

AI.tldr: 本文为多子晶格磁体的均匀磁化动力学建立运动方程，重点研究惯性阻尼力矩，并纳入子晶格内与子晶格间的Gilbert阻尼、反应惯性与惯性阻尼贡献。
AI.motivation: 近来提出的惯性阻尼力矩在多子晶格磁体中的作用尚不清楚，缺乏统一的运动方程与可测量的动力学系数确定方案。
AI.method: 建立包含子晶格内/间Gilbert阻尼、反应惯性及惯性阻尼力矩的均匀磁化运动方程；针对易轴静磁场中的双子晶格单轴反铁磁体，推导各场依赖平衡相的动态磁化率与近似本征频率。
AI.result: 给出了全部场依赖平衡相下的动态磁化率和近似本征频率，并揭示了惯性阻尼对章动模式弛豫的影响。
AI.conclusion: 惯性阻尼显著影响章动模式的弛豫，并提出了一套可用于确定各动力学系数的实验方案。

title: Quantum spectral thermodynamics and active learning enable million-scale exploration of high-entropy ceramics
summary: Understanding phase stability and navigating vast compositional spaces in multicomponent solids remain central challenges in solid-state chemistry. Here, we develop a quantum spectral thermodynamic framework connecting interaction-induced phonon spectral broadening to free energy, alongside an uncertainty-guided active-learning workflow that explores 7.7 million high-entropy ceramic configurations at density-functional-theory fidelity, achieving a $10^5$-fold acceleration. We show that phonon self-energy effects arising from chemical disorder provide an intrinsic vibrational contribution to thermodynamic stabilization beyond ideal configurational entropy, compensating unfavorable mixing enthalpies and suppressing phase separation. Across the chemical space, we uncover a robust ~12 at.% solute threshold separating strengthening and softening regimes, associated with the filling of metal-carbon antibonding states. Chemical disorder further enables an unusual combination of high-temperature mechanical stiffness and low thermal conductivity, together with anomalous temperature-dependent lattice heat transport. This work establishes a quantum spectral foundation for connecting many-body interactions to thermodynamics and phase stability, while providing a scalable framework for exploring previously inaccessible multicomponent chemical spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子谱热力学框架，将相互作用诱导的声子谱展宽与自由能关联，并结合不确定性引导的主动学习，在DFT精度下探索770万种高熵陶瓷构型，实现10^5倍加速。发现化学无序引起的声子自能效应对热力学稳定有本征振动贡献，并揭示~12 at.%溶质阈值及力学-热学反常耦合。
AI.motivation: 多组分固体的相稳定性理解与庞大成分空间探索是固态化学的核心难题，现有人工或计算方法难以在高精度下高效遍历巨大构型空间。
AI.method: 建立量子谱热力学框架，把相互作用诱导的声子谱展宽映射到自由能；采用不确定性引导的主动学习工作流，在密度泛函理论精度下探索770万种高熵陶瓷构型。
AI.result: 实现10^5倍加速；证明化学无序的声子自能效应提供超越理想构型熵的本征振动稳定贡献，补偿不利混合焓并抑制相分离；发现~12 at.%溶质阈值区分强化与软化区，关联金属-碳反键态填充；化学无序带来高温高刚度与低热导率的罕见组合及异常温变晶格热输运。
AI.conclusion: 本工作为连接多体相互作用与热力学、相稳定性奠定量子谱基础，并提供可扩展框架以探索此前难以企及的多组分化学空间。

title: The future of 3D NAND flash technology
summary: 3D NAND flash has become the foundational non-volatile storage platform of the AI era, underpinning workloads from model training to large-scale inference and cold data archival. With roadmaps now targeting kilolayer stacks and tens of trillions of devices per die, scaling is no longer governed primarily by process integration or lithography. Instead, it is increasingly constrained by the physics of charge storage itself: lateral charge migration, electrostatic coupling, read disturb, and transport limitations are entering a margin-limited regime. In this regime, their collective interaction, not any single mechanism, compresses operating margins with each generation. In this Perspective, we examine these converging bottlenecks and argue that sustaining NAND scaling will require application-specific co-optimization rather than a monolithic device roadmap. In this framework, conventional charge-trap flash, ferroelectric storage, alternative channel materials, and system-level integration are best viewed as complementary solutions targeted to distinct tiers of data-centric computing.

AI.tldr: 3D NAND的继续微缩日益受限于电荷存储物理（横向迁移、静电耦合、读干扰、输运限制）而非工艺集成，需转向面向应用的协同优化。
AI.motivation: 3D NAND已是AI时代非易失存储的基石。随路线图迈向千层堆叠与单die数万亿器件，微缩瓶颈从工艺集成/光刻转向电荷存储本身的物理限制，多种机制共同压缩工作裕度。
AI.method: Perspective观点文章：分析横向电荷迁移、静电耦合、读干扰、输运限制等收敛瓶颈，论证应用导向的协同优化框架，将不同存储技术按数据计算层级互补配置。
AI.result: 提出关键判断：多条物理机制的整体相互作用（而非单一机制）是每代工作裕度压缩的主因，传统单体器件路线图难以为继。
AI.conclusion: 维持NAND微缩需应用特定的协同优化，而非统一器件路线图；电荷陷阱闪存、铁电存储、替代沟道材料与系统级集成应视为面向不同数据计算层级的分层互补方案。

title: Structural, electronic, and magnetic properties of HoCo$_2$ thin films grown by pulsed laser deposition
summary: We report the growth and physical properties of HoCo$_2$ thin films on Si substrate by pulsed laser deposition. Well-defined Kiessig fringes in the x-ray reflectivity data yield a film thickness of $35 \pm 1$~nm and demonstrate smooth film surface and interface profiles. Atomic force microscopy confirms the high morphological quality of the films, revealing subnanometer surface roughness of $\sim$170~pm. Two independently prepared films exhibit a reproducible ferrimagnetic transition at $T_{\mathrm{C}}=77\pm3$~K, demonstrating retention of the characteristic magnetic ordering of bulk HoCo$_2$. However, the absence of resolvable thermal hysteresis indicates a predominantly continuous, second-order like transition in the films, in contrast to the first-order transition of bulk HoCo$_2$. At 5~K, the films exhibit clear magnetic hysteresis with a coercive field of $\sim$600~Oe, substantially larger than the negligible coercivity of bulk HoCo$_2$. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals comparable Ho $4d$ and Co $2p$ core-level line shapes and broadly similar valence-band spectra for the bulk and film, indicating preservation of the essential local electronic environment and occupied electronic structure.

AI.tldr: 本文用脉冲激光沉积在Si衬底上生长HoCo₂薄膜，厚度约35 nm、表面粗糙度约170 pm，在77 K附近呈现可重复的亚铁磁转变，但转变趋于连续（二级），且5 K时矫顽力约600 Oe远大于块体。
AI.motivation: HoCo₂块体具有典型的一级磁转变特性，但薄膜形态下的结构与磁性能是否保持尚不清楚；研究薄膜中的磁有序与电子结构有助于理解尺寸/界面效应并推动其在自旋电子学等器件中的应用。
AI.method: 采用脉冲激光沉积（PLD）在Si衬底上制备HoCo₂薄膜；通过X射线反射（XRR）Kiessig fringe确定厚度与界面/表面质量，AFM表征形貌；用磁测量研究磁转变与磁滞；用X射线光电子能谱（XPS）比较薄膜与块体的Ho 4d、Co 2p芯能级及价带谱。
AI.result: 薄膜厚度为35±1 nm，界面和表面平滑，AFM显示表面粗糙度约170 pm；两块独立样品在T_C=77±3 K处出现可重复的亚铁磁转变，但无分辨的热滞，表现为连续/类二级转变，区别于块体的一级转变；5 K下具有明显磁滞，矫顽力约600 Oe，远大于块体可忽略的矫顽力；XPS显示薄膜与块体的Ho 4d、Co 2p线形相近，价带谱大体相似，表明局域电子环境和占据态电子结构基本保持。
AI.conclusion: HoCo₂薄膜保了块体的基本磁有序与电子结构，但磁转变性质由一级变为类二级且低温矫顽力显著增强，说明薄膜的维度/应变/界面效应会显著改其磁行为。

title: Exact vortex decomposition of the shift current
summary: Does any integer survive in the shift current, and does the Chern number control its sign? We show that the shift vector is a singular field on the Brillouin torus. Its curl has two sources: the interband Berry curvature and quantised point charges at the zeros of the transition dipole. Inverting this relation gives an exact decomposition of the shift conductivity, valid at every frequency, into one sector linear in the integer charges and three continuous sectors. As a testing ground, we take a graphene-Haldane bilayer: a model that lets us sweep the interband Chern number through five values at fixed gap to isolate its role. We also test the formalism against the time-reversal-symmetric biased AB bilayer. Whenever a charge sits at the band edge, and trigonal warping is present, the integer sector alone accounts for the band-edge peak. The relevant integer is not the Chern number but the winding of that single charge. Its sign, combined with a valley-dependent profile, sets the sign of the photocurrent. In these bilayers, sign reversals across topological transitions follow this winding; the invariant changes with it only when the same gap closing does both. A band-edge charge needs no invariant. It only requires that the two band-edge sublattices not be connected by the nearest-neighbour hopping, and trigonal warping makes it visible.

AI.tldr: 本文证明shift vector是布里渊环面上的奇异场，其旋度有拓扑点电荷源，据此将shift电导精确分解为整数电荷的线性项与三个连续项，并揭示光电流符号由能带边缘处单个点电荷的绕数而非Chern数决定。
AI.motivation: 探究shift current中是否存在整数量子化、以及Chern数是否控制其符号这一核心争议问题。作者希望澄清拓扑不变量（Chern数）与shift电流符号之间的真实关系。
AI.method: 将shift vector视为布里渊环面上的奇异场，分析其旋度的两个来源：带间Berry曲率与transition dipole零点处的量子化点电荷，并反演该关系得到shift电导的精确分解——一个线性整数电荷扇区和三个连续扇区。以石墨烯-Haldane双层（固定带隙下扫描带间Chern数取五个值）和无偏压AB双层（时间反演对称）作为测试平台。
AI.result: 当电荷位于能带边缘且存在三角warping时，整数扇区单独即可解释能带边缘峰。相关的整数并非Chern数，而是该单个电荷的绕数（winding）。其符号结合谷依赖的profile决定了光电流符号。在双层体系中，跨拓扑相变的符号反转遵循该绕数；仅当同一带隙闭合同时改变两者时，不变量才随之变化。
AI.conclusion: 能带边缘的电荷无需不变量，只需两个带边子晶格不被最近邻hopping连接，三角warping使其可见。这推翻了Chern数主导shift电流符号的传统认知，指出光电流符号由点电荷绕数控制，仅在特定带隙闭合条件下才与Chern数一致。

title: Strain tunability of electron and hole g-factors in CsPb$X_3$: bulk and nanocrystals
summary: In this paper, we theoretically study the electron and hole $g$-factors in inorganic lead-halide perovskites for the reference cubic phase. We employ an 18-band $k \cdot p$ model and determine its parameters using target band structures obtained from DFT calculations. We use the linear response theory to calculate the $g$-factors and investigate their dependence on external strain. We then perform real-space calculations of the electron and hole $g$-factors in perovskite nanocrystals. We show that the bulk $g$-factors can be tuned over a wide range by external strain. In some cases, strain can be used to tune the $g$-factor through zero. By contrast, the carrier $g$-factors in CsPb$X_3$ nanocrystals are considerably less sensitive to strain due to quantum confinement.
